title: 桐壺
summary: 帝（桐壺帝）はそれほど身分が高くない桐壺更衣を寵愛し皇子を儲けるが、更衣はやがて病死する。これを深く嘆く帝を慰めるために亡き更衣に生き写しの藤壺が入内し、新たな寵愛を得る。一方で皇子は帝の元で育てられ、亡き母・桐壺更衣に似るという藤壺をことに慕うようになる。帝は元服した皇子を臣籍降下させて源姓を与える。彼はその光り輝くような美貌から光源氏と呼ばれるようになり、左大臣家娘葵の上の婿に迎えられる。
gendaibun: どの帝の御代であったか、女御や更衣たちが大勢お仕えしている中に、たいして高い身分ではなかったが、だれよりも帝の寵愛を一身に集めていらした方があった。最初から自分こそはとプライドを持っていられた他の御方々は、目ざわりな者として扱い、ますます意地悪くなってゆく。……
gendaibunen: In which emperor's reign was it? Among the many Consorts and Intimates serving at court, there was one who was not of especially high birth, yet she alone received the Emperor's fullest favor. The other ladies, who had prided themselves from the start, treated her as an eyesore and grew ever more spiteful. …
kobun: いづれの御時にか、女御、更衣あまたさぶらひたまひける中に、いとやむごとなき際にはあらぬが、すぐれて時めきたまふありけり。はじめより我はと思ひあがりたまへる御方がた、めざましきものに推しなして、いとどあつしくなりゆき、殿上人なども、あんなりの人の御忍びありきや、心づきなしと思いつつ、怨じの心を加へたる。……
kobunen: In which reign was it? Among the many Consorts and Intimates in service, there was one who, though not of the very highest rank, enjoyed exceptional favor. Ladies who from the first had thought highly of themselves treated her as an affront and grew ever more spiteful; even the courtiers, hearing of the Emperor's secret visits, felt displeased and added their resentment. …

scene.content: 桐壺更衣、玉のような皇子(源氏)を抱いて帝の前に進む。
scene.contenten: Lady Kiritsubo carries the jewel-like prince (Genji) before the Emperor.

scene.content: 桐壺更衣の死後の秋の夜、靫負命婦、帝の命により更衣の里邸にその母を見舞い、帝の文を奉る。
scene.contenten: On an autumn night after Lady Kiritsubo's death, Yuge no Myobu visits the lady's mother by the Emperor's order and delivers his letter.

scene.content: 鴻臚館にて高麗の相人、源氏の相を見る。 右大弁同伴する。
scene.contenten: At the Korokan, a Korean physiognomist reads Genji's features, accompanied by Udaiben.

scene.content: 清涼殿東廂にて源氏元服の儀式。 左大臣加冠の役を務める。
scene.contenten: Genji's coming-of-age ceremony at the east wing of the Seiryoden; the Minister of the Left performs the cap-setting.

scene.content: 源氏の加冠の禄として左大臣に帝より物を賜う。
scene.contenten: The Emperor bestows gifts on the Minister of the Left as reward for Genji's cap-setting.

summaryen: The Emperor (Emperor Kiritsubo) favors Lady Kiritsubo, a woman of no great rank, and she bears him a prince, but she soon falls ill and dies. To console the deeply grieving Emperor, Fujitsubo, the very image of the late lady, enters the palace and wins his new affection. The prince is raised at the Emperor's side and comes to adore Fujitsubo, who resembles his dead mother. After his coming of age the Emperor removes him from the imperial line and grants him the Minamoto surname. For his radiant beauty he becomes known as Hikaru Genji, and is received into the house of the Minister of the Left as husband of Lady Aoi.

title: 帚木
summary: 五月雨のある夜、宮中に宿直する源氏のもとに若い公達が集って「雨夜の品定め」を行う。翌日、物忌みに出向いた邸で、源氏は伊予介の妻・空蝉と関係を持つ。源氏は手なずけた彼女の弟を通じてその後も度々逢瀬を求めるが、空蝉はこれを頑なに拒み続ける。
gendaibun: 五月雨のある夜、宮中に宿直する源氏のもとに若い公達が集って「雨夜の品定め」を行う。翌日、物忌みに出向いた邸で、源氏は伊予介の妻・空蝉と関係を持つ。源氏は手なずけた彼女の弟を通じてその後も度々逢瀬を求めるが、空蝉はこれを頑なに拒み続ける。
gendaibunen: One rainy night in early summer, young courtiers gather around Genji on night duty and debate the virtues of women. The next day, while away for ritual abstinence, Genji becomes involved with Utsusemi, wife of the Governor of Iyo. …
kobun: 五月雨のころ、宮中に宿直したまへる源氏の君のもとに、若き公達あまた集ひて、雨夜の品定めといふことをしける。……
kobunen: On a night of early-summer rain, young nobles gathered where Genji kept night duty at the palace and held their famous “ranking of women on a rainy night.” …

scene.content: 五月雨の夜、源氏の宿直所を頭中将が訪問。 故ありげな消息などに興味を示す。そこへ左馬頭、藤式部丞が加わり女性論議 (雨夜の品定め)。
scene.contenten: On a rainy night in May, To no Chujo visits Genji's night quarters and takes interest in mysterious letters; Sama no Kami and Toshikibu no Jo join a debate on women (the rainy-night ranking).

scene.content: 左馬頭の体験談 女を訪ねるある殿上人に同行したところ簀子に腰掛けて笛を吹く男がいた。 御簾の内より琴を合わせる女はかつて左馬頭が通っていた女であった (木枯しの女)。
scene.contenten: Sama no Kami's tale: accompanying a courtier to a woman's house, they see a man playing a flute on the veranda; inside, a woman answers on the koto, once known to Sama no Kami.

scene.content: 源氏、 方違えで、 中川の紀伊守の邸に行き、歓待される。
scene.contenten: Avoiding an unlucky direction, Genji visits the Governor of Kii's residence at Nakagawa and is entertained.

scene.content: 中川の紀伊守邸に泊まった源氏、 空蝉の部屋をうかがう。従者たちは酔って仮寝。
scene.contenten: Staying at the Governor of Kii's mansion, Genji peers into Utsusemi's room; the attendants, drunk, fall asleep.

scene.content: 空蝉と一夜を明かした源氏、夜明けに空蝉を障子口まで送る。
scene.contenten: After a night with Utsusemi, Genji escorts her to the sliding door at dawn.

summaryen: On a rainy night in early summer, young noblemen gather around Genji while he keeps night watch at court and hold the ranking of women on a rainy night. The next day, at a house he visits for purification, Genji takes up with Utsusemi, the wife of the Governor of Iyo. Through her brother, whom he has won over, he seeks meetings again and again, but Utsusemi stubbornly keeps refusing him.

title: 空蝉
summary: 夏の夕暮、源氏は空蝉と義理の娘・軒端荻が碁を打つのを垣間見て、いよいよ慕情を掻き立てられる。夜に入って源氏が寝間に忍びこむと、空蝉はそれと察して衣だけを脱ぎ捨てて逃げる。蝉の抜殻のごとき着物を抱いて源氏は帰途につく。
gendaibun: 夏の夕暮、源氏は空蝉と義理の娘・軒端荻が碁を打つのを垣間見て、いよいよ慕情を掻き立てられる。夜に入って源氏が寝間に忍びこむと、空蝉はそれと察して衣だけを脱ぎ捨てて逃げる。蝉の抜殻のごとき着物を抱いて源氏は帰途につく。
gendaibunen: On a summer evening Genji spies Utsusemi and her stepdaughter playing go, and his desire deepens. When he slips into her chamber at night, she senses him, escapes, and leaves only a discarded robe—like a cicada's empty shell—in his arms. …
kobun: 寝られたまはぬままには、「我は、かくなむ」と思ひつづけたまひて、空蝉の抜けがらのごとき衣を抱きて、いとど恋ひしきこと限りなし。……
kobunen: Unable to sleep, he thought, “So this is how I am”—and his longing for the lady who had fled like a cicada leaving its shell only grew sharper. …

scene.content: 源氏、小君の手引きで中川の邸に忍び、空輝と軒端荻が碁をうつ姿を隙見する。
scene.contenten: Guided by Kogimi, Genji steals into the Nakagawa mansion and glimpses Utsusemi and Nokiba no Ogi playing go.

scene.content: 源氏、小君の手引きで空蟬と軒端荻とが共寝する部屋に忍び入る。
scene.contenten: Guided by Kogimi, Genji slips into the room where Utsusemi and Nokiba no Ogi sleep together.

scene.content: 忍び入る源氏に気付いた空蟬、部屋をすべりでる。
scene.contenten: Utsusemi, noticing Genji stealing in, slips out of the room.

scene.content: 空蝉と取り違えて軒端荻と一夜を共にした源氏、帰ろうとして、寝入っている小君を起こす。
scene.contenten: Genji, having spent the night with Nokiba no Ogi by mistake, wakes the sleeping Kogimi to leave.

scene.content: 源氏、 空蝉の脱ぎ捨てた薄い衣を取って侘しく部屋を出る。
scene.contenten: Genji takes the thin robe Utsusemi left behind and leaves the room forlornly.

summaryen: On a summer evening, Genji glimpses Utsusemi playing go with her stepdaughter Nokiba no Ogi, and his longing only deepens. When he steals into her chamber at night, Utsusemi senses him, slips off her robe alone, and flees. Clutching the garment like a cicada's cast-off shell, Genji returns home.

title: 夕顔
summary: 源氏は身分を隠したまま五条辺りに住う夕顔と関係を持つ。夕顔は親友・頭中将の元恋人で、行方知れずになっていた人であった。源氏は可憐で素直な夕顔を深く愛するが、ある逢瀬の最中に六条御息所が嫉妬のあまり生霊となって、これをとり殺す。源氏は夕顔の死を深く嘆く。
gendaibun: 源氏は身分を隠したまま五条辺りに住う夕顔と関係を持つ。夕顔は親友・頭中将の元恋人で、行方知れずになっていた人であった。源氏は可憐で素直な夕顔を深く愛するが、ある逢瀬の最中に六条御息所が嫉妬のあまり生霊となって、これをとり殺す。源氏は夕顔の死を深く嘆く。
gendaibunen: While concealing his rank, Genji falls in love with Yūgao near Gojō—once the lost lover of his friend Tō no Chūjō. Their affair ends in terror when the living spirit of Lady Rokujō appears in jealousy during a rendezvous. …
kobun: 六条わたりの御忍び歩きのころ、五条の辺に、夕顔といふ女の住まひけるを見つけて、源氏の君、心ひかれたまひける。……
kobunen: In the days of his secret wanderings about the Sixth Avenue district, Genji came to know a fragile woman called Yūgao, living modestly near Gojō. …

scene.content: 源氏、乳母の家の隣家の垣に咲く夕顔を随身に手折らすと、内より童女が出てきて、花を載せるための扇を差し出す。半蔀を上げたところより女たち、源氏の車を眺める。
scene.contenten: Genji has his attendant pick an evening glory blooming on the fence of his nurse's neighbor; a girl comes out and offers a fan to hold the flowers, while women watch his carriage from the raised shutter.

scene.content: 源氏、惟光に紙燭を持たせて扇をみると、女の移り香が染み、歌が書石の入道の娘の話など、供人たちが語るのを聞いた。
scene.contenten: Genji has Koremitsu bring a lamp; on the fan he finds the woman's lingering scent and a poem, and hears attendants tell of the daughter of the stone-weaving recluse.

scene.content: 六条御息所を訪れた翌朝、源氏、廊まで送りに出た中将の君を振り返りみて歌を交わす。 庭で侍童が朝顔を摘んでいる。
scene.contenten: The morning after visiting the Lady of Rokujo, Genji looks back at the Chujo no Kimi who saw him to the corridor and exchanges poems; a page picks morning glories in the garden.

scene.content: 夕顔の宿に泊まった源氏、変わらぬ愛を誓う。砧の音や祈る年老いた声などが聞こえる。
scene.contenten: Genji stays at Yugao's lodging and pledges unchanging love; he hears fulling mallets and an old woman's prayers.

summaryen: Concealing his rank, Genji takes up with Yugao, who lives near Gojo. She was once the beloved of his close friend the Head Chamberlain and had gone missing. Genji loves the innocent, gentle Yugao deeply, but during one tryst the Rokujo lady's jealousy sends her spirit out to strike her dead. Genji grieves profoundly over Yugao's death.

title: 若紫
summary: 翌年の春、傷心の源氏は病気の加療のため北山に赴き、そこで祖母の尼君とともに住まう美貌の幼女を見かける。藤壺の姪にあたる彼女に源氏は執心し、引き取って手元で育てたいと申し入れるが尼君は応じない。夏、藤壺が病気のため宿下りする。源氏は二度目の密会を行い、直後に彼女の妊娠が発覚する。冬、源氏は北山の幼女を半ば拐うようにして手元に引き取る。若紫と呼ばれる彼女こそ、のちの紫の上である。
gendaibun: 翌年の春、傷心の源氏は病気の加療のため北山に赴き、そこで祖母の尼君とともに住まう美貌の幼女を見かける。藤壺の姪にあたる彼女に源氏は執心し、引き取って手元で育てたいと申し入れるが尼君は応じない。夏、藤壺が病気のため宿下りする。源氏は二度目の密会を行い、直後に彼女の妊娠が発覚する。……
gendaibunen: The next spring, still grieving, Genji seeks treatment in the northern hills and sees a lovely child raised by her grandmother. She is Fujitsubo's niece; Genji longs to bring her up himself, though the nun will not yet agree. …
kobun: 瘧病にわづらひたまひて、北山に加療したまふほどに、尼君のもとに美しくおはする幼き女御子を見たてまつりて、いとど執心深うなりたまひぬ。……
kobunen: Suffering from ague in the spring of the following year, Genji went up to the northern hills for treatment—and there he glimpsed a beautiful little girl living with her grandmother, a nun. …

scene.content: 源氏、加持祈禱の暇々に、散策しながら景色を眺め、諸国の名勝や明石の入道の娘の話など、供人たちが語るのを聞いた。
scene.contenten: Between invocations Genji strolls and views the scenery, hearing his attendants speak of famous places and of the daughter of the Akashi recluse.

scene.content: 源氏、北山の僧都の坊で、逃げた雀を追って縁先に出た美少女(紫の上)を垣間見る。
scene.contenten: At the Bishop's monastery in Kitayama, Genji glimpses a beautiful girl (Murasaki) who comes to the veranda chasing an escaped sparrow.

scene.content: 源氏、一夜尼君の兄の僧都の坊を訪ね、少女の素性を聞く。庭には遣水を引き篝火をともして趣き深いようす。
scene.contenten: Genji visits the Bishop's monastery and asks about the girl's parentage; the garden, with its stream and bonfires, is deeply charming.

scene.content: 源氏、物思いに悩み眠れぬ。滝の音も強くなったように聞こえる。
scene.contenten: Genji lies awake troubled by longing; the sound of the waterfall seems to grow stronger.

scene.content: 左大臣の子息ら、源氏の迎えに来、僧都源氏とともに桜散る山中で酒宴、合奏。
scene.contenten: The Minister of the Left's sons come to fetch Genji; with the Bishop they feast and play music among the falling cherry blossoms.

scene.content: 帰京した尼君を見舞った源氏の声を聞きつけ、紫の君が尼君に会うようにと騒ぐのを女房らたしなめる。
scene.contenten: Hearing Genji's voice after he visits the nun upon returning to the capital, Murasaki clamors to see her, and the ladies restrain her.

scene.content: 尼君亡きあと、源氏は紫の君を訪ね、人見知りする少女を引き寄せ膝の上に休ませようとする。
scene.contenten: After the nun's death, Genji visits Murasaki and tries to take the shy girl onto his knee to rest.

scene.content: 源氏、二条院に引き取った紫の君とともに手習いや雛遊びをして過ごす。
scene.contenten: Genji lives at Nijo-in with Murasaki, amusing themselves with calligraphy and dolls.

summaryen: In the spring of the following year, the heartbroken Genji travels to Kitayama for healing, where he encounters a beautiful young girl living with her grandmother, a nun. She is Fujitsubo's niece; Genji becomes obsessed with her and asks to take her in and raise her himself, but the nun will not consent. In summer, Fujitsubo returns home from court through illness. Genji meets her secretly a second time, and her pregnancy is discovered soon after. In winter, Genji takes the young girl from Kitayama almost by abduction. She, called Murasaki, will later become Murasaki no Ue.

title: 末摘花
summary: 常陸宮の姫君が廃邸にひっそりと暮しているという噂に源氏と頭中将が心惹かれ、競って言い寄る。源氏が一足早く彼女と関係してみると、前評判を裏切る長く垂れた鼻の醜女で源氏は閉口する。鼻の先が紅花で染めたように赤かったことに掛けて、彼女を末摘花という。
gendaibun: 常陸宮の姫君が廃邸にひっそりと暮しているという噂に源氏と頭中将が心惹かれ、競って言い寄る。源氏が一足早く彼女と関係してみると、前評判を裏切る長く垂れた鼻の醜女で源氏は閉口する。鼻の先が紅花で染めたように赤かったことに掛けて、彼女を末摘花という。
gendaibunen: Rumor says the Hitachi Princess lives alone in a decaying house. Genji and Tō no Chūjō both pursue her; when Genji first becomes intimate, he finds her far from the graceful beauty he imagined—and is dismayed by her long, hanging nose. …
kobun: 常陸の宮の姫君、廃れたる邸にひそかに住みたまふと聞こえて、源氏の君も頭中将も、競ひて文通ひたまひける。……
kobunen: Word spread that a princess of Hitachi lived in quiet decline in a ruined mansion; Genji and Tō no Chūjō, drawn by the rumor, competed in their advances. …

scene.content: 月の明るい夜、源氏、常陸宮邸を訪ね、命婦の手引きで姫君 (末摘花)の琴を聞く。庭前に紅梅。
scene.contenten: On a moonlit night Genji visits Hitachi no Miya's residence and, guided by a lady-in-waiting, hears the princess (Suetsumuhana) play the koto; red plum blossoms stand in the garden.

scene.content: 源氏、 常陸宮邸に忍ぶと、身をやつした姿ですでに来ていた頭中将を見いだす。邸内では末摘花、琴を弾く。
scene.contenten: Stealing into Hitachi no Miya's residence, Genji finds To no Chujo already there in disguise; inside, Suetsumuhana plays the koto.

scene.content: 二人は、一つ車で左大臣邸へ向かう。源氏、車の中で笛を吹く。
scene.contenten: The two share a carriage toward the Minister of the Left's residence; Genji plays the flute inside.

scene.content: 冬の夜、末摘花邸を訪ねた源氏が格子を叩くと、女房が灯をとって迎え入れる。
scene.contenten: On a winter night Genji visits Suetsumuhana's residence and knocks at the lattice; a lady-in-waiting brings a light to welcome him.

scene.content: 源氏、常陸宮邸の橘の木の雪を随身に払わせる。
scene.contenten: Genji has his attendant brush the snow off the orange tree at Hitachi no Miya's residence.

scene.content: 源氏、二条院に戻り、紫の君と絵を描き、さらに自分の鼻に紅を塗ってみて紫の君を驚かせる。
scene.contenten: Back at Nijo-in, Genji paints with Murasaki, then smears rouge on his own nose and startles her.

summaryen: Rumor that a princess of the Hitachi Prince lives quietly in a ruined mansion draws Genji and the Head Chamberlain, who compete for her. When Genji wins her first, he finds a homely woman with a long, drooping nose that belies her reputation, and he is put off. Because the tip of her nose is red as if dyed with safflower, he calls her Suetsumuhana, the plucked flower.

title: 紅葉賀
summary: 帝が上皇の長寿のお祝いを紅葉賀と銘打って主催し、源氏はこれに舞を舞う。その舞姿は宮中でも試楽され、藤壺を始め大宮人はその姿に賛嘆する。翌年の春、藤壺が男子を出産する。帝はみずからの子と信じて疑わず、これを現東宮の次の東宮にすえたいと考える。
gendaibun: 帝が上皇の長寿のお祝いを紅葉賀と銘打って主催し、源氏はこれに舞を舞う。その舞姿は宮中でも試楽され、藤壺を始め大宮人はその姿に賛嘆する。翌年の春、藤壺が男子を出産する。帝はみずからの子と信じて疑わず、これを現東宮の次の東宮にすえたいと考える。
gendaibunen: At a maple-viewing feast for the retired emperor's longevity, Genji's dance dazzles the court. The next spring Fujitsubo bears a son; the Emperor believes the child his own, though Genji knows the secret. …
kobun: 朱雀院の行幸は、神無月の十日あまりなりけり。紅葉賀と名づけて、源氏の君舞ひたまへる姿、宮中にも試楽せられ、藤壺を始め、人々感嘆したまひけり。……
kobunen: The Emperor held a maple-viewing celebration for the retired sovereign's longevity, and Genji danced—his figure so radiant that even the rehearsal at court left Fujitsubo and the great ladies in wonder. …

scene.content: 朱雀院行幸の日、源氏、頭中将と青海波を舞う。
scene.contenten: On the day of the Suzaku-in imperial visit, Genji and To no Chujo dance the Seigaiha.

scene.content: 元旦、朝拝に参内する源氏、 雛遊びに熱中している紫の君のもとに立ち寄る。
scene.contenten: On New Year's Day Genji, attending court, stops by Murasaki, who is absorbed in playing with dolls.

scene.content: 藤壺との恋に悩む源氏、気晴らしに笛を吹きながら桂姿で紫の君の居間を覗く。 待ちくたびれた紫の君は不機嫌に横を向いている。
scene.contenten: Troubled by his love for Fujitsubo, Genji in a casual guise plays the flute and peeps into Murasaki's room; tired of waiting, she sulks and turns away.

scene.content: 源氏、機嫌をなおした紫の君に琴を教えたあと、灯火をつけて二人で絵を見る。
scene.contenten: After teaching a now-cheerful Murasaki the koto, Genji lights a lamp and the two look at pictures.

scene.content: 源氏、温明殿の辺りを歩き、琵琶を弾く源内侍と戯れる。
scene.contenten: Genji walks near the Unmeiden and frolics with Gen'nai no Naishi, who plays the biwa.

summaryen: The Emperor holds a celebration of the retired Emperor's long life under the name of the Red Leaves, and Genji performs a dance. The dance is rehearsed at court as well, and Fujitsubo and the courtiers marvel at it. The following spring, Fujitsubo gives birth to a boy. The Emperor believes him to be his own child without doubt, and wishes to make him heir after the present Crown Prince.

title: 花宴
summary: 翌年の春、宮中の観桜の宴の後、源氏はさる姫君と関係を持つ。春の末、政敵・右大臣家の宴に招かれた源氏は、彼女がまもなくみずからの兄の元に入内する右大臣の娘・朧月夜の君であることを知る。
gendaibun: 翌年の春、宮中の観桜の宴の後、源氏はさる姫君と関係を持つ。春の末、政敵・右大臣家の宴に招かれた源氏は、彼女がまもなくみずからの兄の元に入内する右大臣の娘・朧月夜の君であることを知る。
gendaibunen: After a spring cherry-viewing banquet at court, Genji becomes involved with a young lady. Later, invited to a feast at the house of his political rivals, he learns she is Oborozukiyo—daughter of the Minister of the Right, soon to enter service at the palace. …
kobun: 如月の二十日あまり、南殿の桜の宴せさせたまひて後、源氏の君、ある姫君と逢ひたまひけるが、やがて朧月夜の君なりけり。……
kobunen: Past the twentieth of the Second Month, a cherry-blossom banquet was held at the Southern Hall; afterward Genji found himself drawn into an unexpected encounter with a certain lady. …

scene.content: 桜花の宴の果てた月夜、源氏、弘徽殿の細殿で扇をかざして歩いてくる女朧月夜)に逢う。
scene.contenten: On a moonlit night after the cherry-blossom banquet, Genji meets a woman (Oborozukiyo) walking with a fan in the corridor of the Kokiden.

scene.content: 一夜を過ごした女は相手が源氏と知ってか、慌てず、二人は扇を取り換えて別れる。
scene.contenten: After the night, the woman stays calm even on learning her lover is Genji; the two exchange fans and part.

scene.content: 右大臣邸の藤花の宴に招かれた源氏、 花宴の夜の女を探し、女一宮、女三宮のいる部屋の御簾を引く。 源氏は裾を長く引いた大君姿。
scene.contenten: Invited to the wisteria banquet at the Minister of the Right's residence, Genji seeks the woman of the banquet night and pulls aside the blinds of the room of the First and Third Princesses; Genji wears a long-trailed court-lady's guise.

scene.content: 女(朧月夜)を捜し当てた源氏、几帳ごしに手を取り歌を交わす。
scene.contenten: Finding the woman (Oborozukiyo), Genji takes her hand through the screen and exchanges poems.

summaryen: In the spring of the following year, after the cherry-blossom viewing at court, Genji takes up with a certain princess. At the end of spring, invited to a banquet at the house of his political rival the Minister of the Right, he learns that she is the Minister's daughter, Lady Oborozukiyo, who is soon to enter the palace as the consort of his own brother.

title: 葵
summary: 二年後。桐壺帝はすでに退位し、源氏の兄・朱雀帝が即位している。賀茂祭の折、車の場所争いのことで六条御息所は葵の上によって辱めを受け、これを深く恨む。折から妊娠していた葵の上は産褥で御息所の生霊に苦しめられ、無事男子（夕霧）を出産するものの亡くなる。夏の終わり、源氏は紫の上と新枕を交わす。
gendaibun: 二年後。桐壺帝はすでに退位し、源氏の兄・朱雀帝が即位している。賀茂祭の折、車の場所争いのことで六条御息所は葵の上によって辱めを受け、これを深く恨む。折から妊娠していた葵の上は産褥で御息所の生霊に苦しめられ、無事男子（夕霧）を出産するものの亡くなる。夏の終わり、源氏は紫の上と新枕を交わす。
gendaibunen: Two years later the Kiritsubo Emperor has abdicated and Suzaku reigns. At the Kamo Festival a quarrel over carriage places humiliates Lady Rokujō before Aoi; her living spirit then torments the pregnant Aoi in childbed. …
kobun: 世の中かはりて後、よろづもの憂く思され、賀茂の祭の車争いにより、六条御息所、葵の上に辱められたまひて、深く恨みたまひける。……
kobunen: After the world had changed, everything felt wearisome; two years on, the Kiritsubo Emperor had already abdicated, and Genji's elder brother reigned as Emperor Suzaku. …

scene.content: 斎院の御禊行列見物の葵の上一行、やはり見物にきていた六条御息所の車と遭遇、召使いたち御息所の車を押しのける(車争い)。
scene.contenten: Lady Aoi's procession viewing the Kamo purification meets the carriage of the Lady of Rokujo, also viewing; Aoi's servants push Rokujo's carriage aside (the carriage quarrel).

scene.content: 源氏、賀茂祭見物に紫の君を連れ出そうとし、その髪を自らそぐ。
scene.contenten: Genji tries to take Murasaki to see the Kamo festival and trims her hair himself.

scene.content: 秋の朝、六条御息所から届いた、菊の枝につけられた見舞いの文に返歌をしたためる源氏。
scene.contenten: On an autumn morning Genji writes a reply to Lady Rokujo's get-well letter attached to a chrysanthemum branch.

summaryen: Two years later. Emperor Kiritsubo has already abdicated, and Genji's brother, Emperor Suzaku, has taken the throne. At the time of the Kamo festival, the Rokujo lady is humiliated by Lady Aoi in a dispute over carriage space and resents it deeply. Lady Aoi, then pregnant, suffers in childbirth from the Rokujo lady's spirit and, after safely bearing a boy (Yugiri), dies. At summer's end, Genji spends his first night with Murasaki no Ue.

title: 賢木
summary: 六条御息所はみずからの生霊の恐ろしさに怯え、娘が伊勢斎宮となったのを機に、ともに伊勢に下ることを決意して嵯峨野の野宮に籠もって潔斎する。秋の終わり、源氏は彼女を訪い、名残を惜しむ。冬、桐壺帝崩御。藤壺も源氏との関係を思い悩み、出家する。源氏と朧月夜は彼女の入内後も関係を続けていたために、翌年夏、密会の場を右大臣に見つけられる。これを口実に、桐壺帝の死で激化しつつあった政争で、右大臣派は源氏を陥れようとする。
gendaibun: 六条御息所はみずからの生霊の恐ろしさに怯え、娘が伊勢斎宮となったのを機に、ともに伊勢に下ることを決意して嵯峨野の野宮に籠もって潔斎する。秋の終わり、源氏は彼女を訪い、名残を惜しむ。冬、桐壺帝崩御。藤壺も源氏との関係を思い悩み、出家する。……
gendaibunen: Lady Rokujō, frightened by her own spirit's violence, decides to accompany her daughter—the new Ise Priestess—and enters ritual seclusion at the Field Palace. Late in autumn Genji visits to take leave; that winter the Kiritsubo Emperor dies. …
kobun: 斎宮の御下り近うなりゆくままに、六条御息所、みづからの生霊の恐ろしさに怯え、娘とともに伊勢へ下らむとて、嵯峨野の野宮に籠もりたまひけり。……
kobunen: Terrified by the horror of her own living spirit, Lady Rokujō resolved to withdraw with her daughter, now chosen as Ise Priestess, and entered purification at the Field Palace in Sagano. …

scene.content: 晩秋の野宮に六条御息所を訪ねた源氏、榊の枝を御簾の中に差し入れ、歌を交わす。
scene.contenten: Visiting the Lady of Rokujo at the Nonomiya in late autumn, Genji slips a sakaki branch through the blinds and exchanges poems.

scene.content: 桐壺帝崩御後、三条宮に下る藤壺中宮を源氏と螢兵部卿宮が見舞い慰める。庭の池は凍り、五葉松に雪降り積もる。
scene.contenten: After Emperor Kiritsubo's death, Genji and Hotaru Hyobukyo no Miya visit and comfort Fujitsubo, now moving to Sanjo Palace; the garden pond freezes and snow piles on the five-needle pine.

scene.content: 藤壺を慕って忍びいった源氏、屏風の狭間を伝って藤壺の室に入り込もうとする。
scene.contenten: Longing for Fujitsubo, Genji steals in and tries to enter her chamber through a gap in the screens.

scene.content: 雲林院に籠もった源氏より文をつけて届けられた紅葉を藤壺うとましく思い、瓶にいれて廂の柱のもとに遠ざける。
scene.contenten: Fujitsubo finds the autumn leaves sent with a poem by Genji, cloistered at Unrin-in, distasteful, and has them placed in a vase by a gallery pillar.

scene.content: 桐壺院の一周忌の後まもなく藤壺出家。驚いた源氏、命婦を介して悲しみを訴える。雪に月、くまなく照る。
scene.contenten: Soon after the first anniversary of Emperor Kiritsubo, Fujitsubo takes the tonsure; shocked, Genji laments through Myobu; snow and moon shine everywhere.

summaryen: Frightened by the terror of her own spirit, the Rokujo lady, when her daughter becomes the Ise Priestess, resolves to go down to Ise with her and secludes herself at Sagano for purification. At the end of autumn, Genji visits her to bid a reluctant farewell. In winter, Emperor Kiritsubo dies. Fujitsubo, anguished over her relationship with Genji, takes the tonsure. Because Genji and Oborozukiyo continued their affair after she entered the palace, their secret meeting is discovered by the Minister of the Right the following summer. Using this as a pretext, the Minister's faction, amid a political struggle intensified by Emperor Kiritsubo's death, seeks to ruin Genji.

title: 花散里
summary: 五月雨の晴れ間、源氏は故桐壺院の女御の一人・麗景殿女御のもとを訪れる。ひっそりと物静かな、昔語りのゆかしい風情に住みなしている人のもとで、源氏は父帝在世の頃をしのぶ。後に妻の一人となる女御の妹・花散里との出会いは作中に記述されておらず、この巻で久々の再会と言うかたちをとる。
gendaibun: 五月雨の晴れ間、源氏は故桐壺院の女御の一人・麗景殿女御のもとを訪れる。ひっそりと物静かな、昔語りのゆかしい風情に住みなしている人のもとで、源氏は父帝在世の頃をしのぶ。後に妻の一人となる女御の妹・花散里との出会いは作中に記述されておらず、この巻で久々の再会と言うかたちをとる。
gendaibunen: Between showers of the rainy season, Genji visits a former consort of his late father at Reikeiden. In that quiet, nostalgic household he remembers the old reign; her sister, Hanachirusato, will later become one of his wives. …
kobun: 五月雨の晴れ間、源氏の君、故桐壺院の女御の住まひたる麗景殿を訪ひたまひて、ひそかなる昔語りの風情に、父帝の御代をしのびたまひける。……
kobunen: In a break of the early-summer rains, Genji visited one of the late Kiritsubo Emperor's consorts at Reikeiden—a quiet house fragrant with old stories. …

scene.content: 源氏、中川辺りで、聞こえた琴の音に興を引かれ惟光を入らす。 門前に桂の木あり、時鳥鳴き過ぎる。
scene.contenten: Near Nakagawa, drawn by a koto, Genji sends Koremitsu in; a katsura tree stands before the gate and a cuckoo calls as it passes.

scene.content: 源氏、麗景殿女御 (花散里の姉)のもとでも時鳥を聞き、昔話をしてから、花散里に逢う。
scene.contenten: At the Reikeiden Consort's (Hanachirusato's elder sister) Genji hears a cuckoo, talks of old times, and then meets Hanachirusato.

summaryen: During a break in the summer rains, Genji visits the Reikeiden Lady, one of the late Emperor Kiritsubo's consorts. In the quiet, nostalgic society of a woman who lives amid old tales, Genji recalls the days of his father's reign. His meeting with the lady's younger sister, Hanachirusato, who will become one of his wives, is not described in the work; here it takes the form of a reunion after long years.

title: 須磨
summary: 罪せられそうな気配を敏感に察し、源氏は先手を打って須磨に隠遁する。関わりのある女君たちに別れを告げ、紫の上の身上を心配しつつ京を去る源氏の姿は、あわれぶかい。翌年春、海辺に源氏が上巳の禊を行うと天に嵐がおこる。一方で隣国の明石入道は、須磨に源氏が仮寓することを知って娘との結婚を画策する。
gendaibun: 罪せられそうな気配を敏感に察し、源氏は先手を打って須磨に隠遁する。関わりのある女君たちに別れを告げ、紫の上の身上を心配しつつ京を去る源氏の姿は、あわれぶかい。翌年春、海辺に源氏が上巳の禊を行うと天に嵐がおこる。一方で隣国の明石入道は、須磨に源氏が仮寓することを知って娘との結婚を画策する。
gendaibunen: Foreseeing disgrace, Genji goes into exile at Suma of his own will. Parting from the women he loves and worrying for Murasaki, he leaves the capital in deep pathos. The next spring a storm rises as he performs a seaside purification. …
kobun: 罪せられむ気配を察し、源氏の君、先手を打ちて須磨に隠遁したまふ。女君たちに別れを告げ、紫の上の身上を案じつつ、京を出でたまひける。……
kobunen: Sensing that punishment might soon fall, Genji took the initiative and withdrew into exile at Suma, bidding farewell to the women bound to him and fretting over Murasaki's fate as he left the capital. …

scene.content: 源氏、暇乞いのためひそかに左大臣邸を訪れ、夕霧を膝に載せて涙する。左大臣も渡ってくる。
scene.contenten: To take leave, Genji secretly visits the Minister of the Left's residence and weeps with Yugiri on his knee; the Minister also comes over.

scene.content: 左大臣邸の女房、中納言の君のもとで一泊した源氏、帰りぎわに勾欄によって桜を眺める。中納言の君、妻戸を開けて見送る。
scene.contenten: After a night at the Minister's residence with the Chunagon no Kimi, Genji gazes at cherry blossoms from the balustrade on leaving; she opens the door to see him off.

scene.content: 流謫の源氏、須磨の秋の夜に一人琴を弾き謡う。惟光ら、目覚めて都を偲んですすり泣く。
scene.contenten: In exile at Suma, Genji plays the koto and sings alone on an autumn night; Koremitsu and the others wake and weep longing for the capital.

scene.content: 源氏、海の見える廊に出て、 沖行く舟や雁の列を眺める。
scene.contenten: Genji goes out to the corridor overlooking the sea and watches boats and lines of wild geese.

scene.content: 雪の降る日、源氏七弦琴を弾き、良清に歌わせ、 惟光に笛を吹かせて遊ぶ。
scene.contenten: On a snowy day Genji plays the seven-stringed koto, has Yoshikiyo sing, and Koremitsu play the flute.

scene.content: 春となり、都の桜を偲ぶ源氏のもとを頭中将が見舞う。竹を編んだ垣を巡らせた唐風の山荘のようす。
scene.contenten: In spring To no Chujo visits Genji, who longs for the capital's cherries; a Chinese-style villa ringed by a bamboo fence.

scene.content: 頭中将と源氏、ともに山荘の馬が稲を喰うさまを珍しく眺める。
scene.contenten: Genji and To no Chujo watch with amusement a horse eating rice plants at the villa.

scene.content: 三月朔日上巳の日、源氏、浜で御禊、天変突発して暴風雨となる。
scene.contenten: On the third day of the third month Genji performs purification at the beach; a sudden storm breaks.

summaryen: Sensing the signs of impending punishment, Genji outmaneuvers it by retiring to Suma. Taking leave of the ladies bound to him and worrying over Murasaki no Ue's fate, his departure from the capital is deeply moving. The following spring, when Genji performs a purification on the beach, a storm breaks out. Meanwhile the Akashi recluse in the neighboring province, learning of Genji's stay in Suma, plots marriage to his daughter.

title: 明石
summary: 父帝の夢告により源氏は須磨を離れ、明石入道がこれを迎え入れる。入道の娘・明石の御方と源氏は関係し、やがて妊娠の兆候があらわれる。一方都では朱雀帝の夢に桐壺帝があらわれ、源氏は無実の旨を告げて叱責する。帝は源氏追放を悔いて勅旨によって帰京を命じる。源氏は明石の御方に心を残しつつ、京へと戻る。
gendaibun: 父帝の夢告により源氏は須磨を離れ、明石入道がこれを迎え入れる。入道の娘・明石の御方と源氏は関係し、やがて妊娠の兆候があらわれる。一方都では朱雀帝の夢に桐壺帝があらわれ、源氏は無実の旨を告げて叱責する。帝は源氏追放を悔いて勅旨によって帰京を命じる。源氏は明石の御方に心を残しつつ、京へと戻る。
gendaibunen: After a dream-message from his father, Genji leaves Suma and is welcomed by the Akashi Novice. He becomes involved with the Novice's daughter, the Lady of Akashi, who soon shows signs of pregnancy. In the capital, Emperor Suzaku dreams of rebuke for Genji's unjust exile. …
kobun: 父帝の夢告により、源氏の君須磨を立ちて、明石入道これに迎え入れたてまつる。入道の娘・明石の御方と逢ひたまひて、やがて懐妊のけしき見えけり。……
kobunen: Warned in a dream by his father the late Emperor, Genji left Suma; the Akashi Novice received him, and in time Genji became intimate with the Novice's daughter. …

scene.content: 源氏の夢に桐壺帝の現われた翌朝、夢のお告げどおり、明石の入道よりの迎えの舟がつく。
scene.contenten: The morning after Emperor Kiritsubo appears in Genji's dream, a boat sent by the Akashi recluse arrives, as the dream foretold.

scene.content: 入道邸に移った源氏、初夏の夕月夜に琴を奏で、入道は琵琶を弾く。
scene.contenten: Moved to the recluse's residence, Genji plays the koto on an early-summer moonlit evening; the recluse plays the biwa.

scene.content: 八月十三夜、源氏、馬に乗り、入江沿いに明石の君のもとに向かう。
scene.contenten: On the thirteenth night of the eighth month, Genji rides along the inlet toward Lady Akashi.

scene.content: 明石の君、几帳の傍らで箏を弾きさしているところへ、源氏訪れる。
scene.contenten: Lady Akashi plays the koto at the side of a screen; Genji visits.

scene.content: 明石の浦出立も間もない源氏、明石の君と一夜を過ごし琴を弾く。
scene.contenten: Soon before leaving Akashi Bay, Genji spends a night with Lady Akashi, playing the koto.

scene.content: 琴の音に堪えられず、 入道、箏を娘に促し、御簾の内へと差し入れる。
scene.contenten: Unable to bear the music, the recluse urges his daughter to play and slips a koto inside the blinds.

summaryen: Warned by his father the Emperor in a dream, Genji leaves Suma, and the Akashi recluse welcomes him. Genji takes up with the recluse's daughter, Lady Akashi, and signs of her pregnancy soon appear. Meanwhile in the capital, Emperor Kiritsubo appears in Emperor Suzaku's dream and rebukes him, declaring Genji innocent. The Emperor, regretting Genji's exile, orders his return by imperial decree. Genji returns to the capital, leaving his heart with Lady Akashi.

title: 澪標
summary: 帰京後、源氏は順調に政界に復帰し、栄耀の道を歩みはじめる。年変わって、朱雀帝が退位する。実は源氏と藤壺の子でありながら東宮であった冷泉帝が即位する。秋、源氏は須磨明石の流浪を守護した住吉明神に詣でる。明石の御方もたまたまこれに来合わせていたが再会はできなかった。また新帝即位により斎宮が交替し、六条御息所とその娘の斎宮が帰京。間もなく御息所は病死する。源氏は御息所の遺言にしたがって彼女を養女とし、冷泉帝に入内させて斎宮女御とする。
gendaibun: 帰京後、源氏は順調に政界に復帰し、栄耀の道を歩みはじめる。年変わって、朱雀帝が退位する。実は源氏と藤壺の子でありながら東宮であった冷泉帝が即位する。秋、源氏は須磨明石の流浪を守護した住吉明神に詣でる。明石の御方もたまたまこれに来合わせていたが再会はできなかった。……
gendaibunen: Back in the capital, Genji returns to power. Suzaku abdicates; Reizei—secretly Genji and Fujitsubo's son—ascends the throne. In autumn Genji makes pilgrimage to Sumiyoshi, grateful for protection during his wanderings at Suma and Akashi. …
kobun: 帰京の後、源氏の君、政界に復帰したまひて栄えゆく。年改まりて朱雀帝退位し、冷泉帝即位したまふ。秋、住吉の明神に詣でたまひける。……
kobunen: After his return, Genji rose again in politics and walked the path of glory; the year turned, and Emperor Suzaku abdicated. …

scene.content: 明石の君、姫君のために源氏が遣わした乳母とともに源氏よりの文を読み語り合う。
scene.contenten: Lady Akashi reads and discusses with the nurse sent by Genji, for her daughter's sake, the letter from him.

scene.content: 明石の君よりの文を繰り返し読む源氏、恨み顔の紫の上に明石の君の美しい手跡を見せる。
scene.contenten: Rereading Lady Akashi's letter, Genji shows her beautiful handwriting to the pouting Murasaki.

scene.content: 五月の朧月夜、源氏、 花散里を訪れ、荒れた庭を見ながら間近で鳴く水鶏を聞いて歌を交わす。
scene.contenten: On a hazy moonlit night in May, Genji visits Hanachirusato, hearing a water rail cry close by as they view the neglected garden and exchange poems.

scene.content: 秋、源氏供人を整え、住吉詣。 源氏の栄華を目のあたりにした明石の君の住吉詣の舟はそのまま住吉の浜を去る。
scene.contenten: In autumn Genji sets out for Sumiyoshi with attendants; the boat of Lady Akashi, who has seen Genji's glory, leaves Sumiyoshi beach as it is.

scene.content: 源氏一行、難波に行き、明石の君の舟と邂逅。明石の君への歌を口ずさむ源氏に惟光は筆と硯を奉る。
scene.contenten: Genji's party goes to Naniwa and encounters Lady Akashi's boat; as Genji hums a poem to her, Koremitsu offers brush and inkstone.

scene.content: 病のため出家した六条御息所を見舞った源氏、几帳の隙間より斎宮を垣間見る。
scene.contenten: Genji visits the Lady of Rokujo, who has taken the tonsure through illness, and glimpses the Saiin through a gap in the curtain.

summaryen: After returning to the capital, Genji steadily recovers his position and begins a career of glory. In the new year, Emperor Suzaku abdicates. Emperor Reizei, who in truth is the son of Genji and Fujitsubo, ascends the throne. In autumn, Genji worships at Sumiyoshi, the deity who protected him during his wanderings in Suma and Akashi. Lady Akashi also happened to come there, but no reunion came about. With the new emperor's accession the Ise Priestess is replaced, and the Rokujo lady and her daughter the Priestess return to the capital. Soon after, the lady dies. Following her testament, Genji adopts her daughter and has her enter Emperor Reizei's court as the Priestess Consort.

title: 蓬生
summary: 源氏逼塞の間、ほかに頼るものとてない末摘花は一途に彼を待ち続け、落魄の生活にも耐えていた。帰京した源氏は彼女を訪れ、その純情に心を動かされる。
gendaibun: 源氏逼塞の間、ほかに頼るものとてない末摘花は一途に彼を待ち続け、落魄の生活にも耐えていた。帰京した源氏は彼女を訪れ、その純情に心を動かされる。
gendaibunen: During Genji's disgrace, Suetsumuhana has no other protector and waits for him through hardship. When he returns to the capital and visits her, her steadfast devotion moves him. …
kobun: 源氏の君の逼塞のほど、末摘花、ほかに頼む方なく、ひたすら待ち続けて、落魄の住居にも耐へたまひける。……
kobunen: While Genji lay low in exile, Suetsumuhana, with no one else to rely on, waited for him alone and endured a life of ruinous poverty. …

scene.content: 末摘花邸荒廃する。
scene.contenten: Suetsumuhana's residence falls into ruin.

scene.content: 荒れ果てた邸内で、困窮した暮しを続ける末摘花、かぐや姫物語などを絵に描いたものなど引き出してみて無聊を慰める。
scene.contenten: In the desolate mansion, impoverished Suetsumuhana brings out pictures of the Tale of the Bamboo Cutter and the like to relieve her boredom.

scene.content: 末摘花の伯母、筑紫下向に際して末摘花を伴おうと荒れた邸を訪れ、わずかに格子の開いている南面に無作法に車を寄せる。
scene.contenten: Suetsumuhana's aunt comes to the ruined mansion to take her along on a journey to Tsukushi, rudely drawing her carriage up to the south side where a lattice stands ajar.

scene.content: 源氏、花散里訪問の途上、松に藤のかかる荒廃した末摘花邸に気付き、惟光にようすをうかがわせる。
scene.contenten: On the way to visit Hanachirusato, Genji notices the ruined residence with wisteria over the pines and has Koremitsu inquire.

scene.content: 末摘花邸の蓬の生い茂る庭を、惟光に露を払わせながら源氏進む。
scene.contenten: Genji advances through the mugwort-grown garden of Suetsumuhana's residence as Koremitsu brushes the dew aside.

scene.content: 末摘花と再会した源氏、松(待つ)にことよせて歌を詠み、慰める。
scene.contenten: Reunited with Suetsumuhana, Genji composes a poem on the pine (matsu, to wait) to comfort her.

summaryen: While Genji was in seclusion, Suetsumuhana, with no one else to rely on, waited single-mindedly for him and endured a life of decline. Returning to the capital, Genji visits her and is moved by her pure devotion.

title: 関屋
summary: 夫に従って常陸に下っていた空蝉が帰京する。石山寺参詣の途次、その行列に行合わせた源氏は思わず歌の贈答を行う。
gendaibun: 夫に従って常陸に下っていた空蝉が帰京する。石山寺参詣の途次、その行列に行合わせた源氏は思わず歌の贈答を行う。
gendaibunen: Utsusemi returns from Hitachi with her husband. On a pilgrimage toward Ishiyamadera her party meets Genji's; before they know it they exchange poems. …
kobun: 夫に従ひて常陸に下りたまひし空蝉、帰京の途次、石山寺参詣の源氏の君の行列と行き合ひて、思はず歌の贈答ありけり。……
kobunen: Utsusemi, who had gone down to Hitachi with her husband, was returning to the capital; on the road to Ishiyama Temple her procession crossed Genji's, and they could not help exchanging poems. …

scene.content: 源氏、石山詣の途次、秋の逢坂の関で上京途中の常陸介・空蝉の一行に逢う。空蝉らは源氏の行列に道を譲り、木陰に車を引き入れて、行列を見送る。
scene.contenten: On the way to Ishiyama, Genji meets the party of Hitachi no Suke and Utsusemi traveling to the capital at Osaka Barrier in autumn; they yield the road, draw their carriage into the shade, and watch the procession.

scene.content: 左衛門佐（小君）、源氏の車に近づき、車から差し出された文を受け取る。
scene.contenten: Saemon no Suke (Kogimi) approaches Genji's carriage and receives a letter offered from it.

scene.content: 石山より戻った源氏、左衛門佐に会い、空蝉への文を託す。
scene.contenten: Returning from Ishiyama, Genji meets Saemon no Suke and entrusts him with a letter to Utsusemi.

summaryen: Utsusemi, who had gone down to Hitachi with her husband, returns to the capital. On the way to worship at Ishiyama-dera, Genji falls in with her procession and impulsively exchanges poems with her.

title: 絵合
summary: 冷泉帝の後宮に時めく六条御息所の娘・斎宮女御（梅壺女御。のちの秋好中宮）と権中納言の姫君・弘徽殿女御は、それぞれかつての親友であった源氏と頭中将（ここでは権中納言）が後盾となって寵を競っている。宮中に絵合が行われることになり、二人はおのおのみずからの姫君を勝たせるべく絵巻の収集に余念がない。絵合の当日、源氏が須磨流浪の折の自筆の絵巻が藤壺と冷泉帝に賞賛され、斎宮女御方の勝ちとなる。
gendaibun: 冷泉帝の後宮に時めく六条御息所の娘・斎宮女御（梅壺女御。のちの秋好中宮）と権中納言の姫君・弘徽殿女御は、それぞれかつての親友であった源氏と頭中将（ここでは権中納言）が後盾となって寵を競っている。宮中に絵合が行われることになり、二人はおのおのみずからの姫君を勝たせるべく絵巻の収集に余念がない。……
gendaibunen: At Reizei's court, the former Ise Priestess (Lady Rokujō's daughter) and the Kokiden Consort compete for favor, backed respectively by Genji and Tō no Chūjō. A picture contest at the palace becomes the stage for their rivalry. …
kobun: 冷泉帝の後宮に、斎宮女御と弘徽殿女御、寵を競ひたまふ。源氏の君と権中納言、それぞれ後見として、絵合の場に臨みたまひける。……
kobunen: In Emperor Reizei's court, the Ise Consort—daughter of Lady Rokujō—and the Kokiden Consort vied for favor, each backed by Genji and by Tō no Chūjō, once the closest of friends. …

scene.content: 冷泉帝は絵を好み、梅壺女御も絵をよくするので、帝は梅壺の局にしばしば通って絵を描かせる。
scene.contenten: Emperor Reizei loves pictures, and Lady Umetsubo paints well, so the Emperor often visits her chamber to have her paint.

scene.content: 源氏、絵合せのための絵を選び、紫の上に須磨の絵日記を見せる。
scene.contenten: Genji selects pictures for a picture contest and shows Murasaki the Suma picture diary.

scene.content: 藤壺、絵合せを催す。女房たち、二手に分かれて、優劣を論じ合う。
scene.contenten: Fujitsubo holds a picture contest; the ladies divide into two sides and debate superiority.

scene.content: 冷泉帝御前での絵合せ。 左右よりの絵を沈や紫檀の箱にいれ、人々居並ぶ。藤壺も臨席。
scene.contenten: The picture contest before Emperor Reizei: pictures from left and right are placed in aloeswood and rosewood boxes as people line up; Fujitsubo also attends.

scene.content: 絵合せ後の竟宴。
scene.contenten: The after-contest feast following the picture contest.

summaryen: The Priestess Consort (Lady Ume), daughter of the Rokujo lady who flourishes in Emperor Reizei's court, and Lady Kokiden, daughter of the Gon Chunagon, each backed by Genji and the Gon Chunagon (formerly the Head Chamberlain), vie for favor. A picture contest is to be held at court, and the two spare no effort collecting picture scrolls so that their own princess may win. On the day of the contest, the scrolls Genji painted himself during his wanderings in Suma win praise from Fujitsubo and Emperor Reizei, and the Priestess Consort's side prevails.

title: 松風
summary: 源氏は明石の御方に上洛をうながすが、身分を恥じる彼女はなかなか肯んじえない。入道の薦めによりやっと大堰川あたりの別邸へ忍んで上京した彼女を源氏は喜び迎え、姫君とも親子の対面を果たす。源氏に事情を聞いた紫の上はみずからに子のないことに引きくらべ嫉妬を覚えるが、ゆくゆくは姫君を紫の上の養女としようという源氏の言葉に喜ぶ。
gendaibun: 源氏は明石の御方に上洛をうながすが、身分を恥じる彼女はなかなか肯んじえない。入道の薦めによりやっと大堰川あたりの別邸へ忍んで上京した彼女を源氏は喜び迎え、姫君とも親子の対面を果たす。源氏に事情を聞いた紫の上はみずからに子のないことに引きくらべ嫉妬を覚えるが、ゆくゆくは姫君を紫の上の養女としようという源氏の言葉に喜ぶ。
gendaibunen: Genji presses the Lady of Akashi to move to the capital; shy of her status, she hesitates. Encouraged by her father, she finally comes quietly to a villa by the Ōi; Genji rejoices and is reunited with their little daughter. …
kobun: 源氏の君、明石の御方に上洛をすすめ給へど、身分を恥ぢてなかなかに受けがたし。入道のすすめで大堰の辺へ忍び上りたまひしを、喜び迎へたまひける。……
kobunen: Genji urged the Lady of Akashi to come up to the capital, yet ashamed of her birth she long refused; at last, by her father's counsel, she slipped north to a villa by the Ōi River. …

scene.content: 明石の君母子、舟で上洛。入道、舟を見送る。
scene.contenten: Lady Akashi and her child come up to the capital by boat; the recluse sees them off.

scene.content: 上京して大堰の山荘に住む明石の君、源氏の形見の琴を弾く。松風、音を合わせるように鳴る。傍らに明石の尼君。
scene.contenten: Lady Akashi, now at the Oi villa in the capital, plays the koto left as Genji's keepsake; the wind in the pines sounds as if accompanying; the Akashi nun is beside her.

scene.content: 大堰の山荘より帰ろうとする源氏を乳母、姫君を抱いて見送る。 明石の君は几帳の陰に伏す。
scene.contenten: As Genji prepares to leave the Oi villa, the nurse sees him off holding the princess; Lady Akashi lies hidden behind a screen.

scene.content: 源氏、桂殿にて遊宴。 迎えの人々、 荻の枝に小鳥をつけて奉る。
scene.contenten: Genji feasts at the Katsura Palace; his escorts present a small bird tied to a branch of eulalia.

scene.content: 夜更け、紫の上のところにいる源氏のもとへ、明石の君の文が届く。源氏、読んでから紫の上にも見せ、脇息によって明石の君を想う。
scene.contenten: Late at night a letter from Lady Akashi arrives for Genji at Murasaki's; after reading it he shows it to Murasaki and, leaning on an armrest, longs for Lady Akashi.

summaryen: Genji urges Lady Akashi to come up to the capital, but she, ashamed of her rank, cannot easily consent. At the recluse's urging she at last steals up to a villa near the Oi River, and Genji gladly welcomes her and brings about a meeting between her and their daughter. Murasaki no Ue, hearing of the matter from Genji, feels jealousy comparing her own childlessness, but rejoices at Genji's words that the daughter shall eventually become her adopted child.

title: 薄雲
summary: 明石の姫君が源氏のもとへ引きとられ、大堰の別邸では親子の悲しい別れが繰り広げられる。翌年の春、藤壺が崩御し、源氏の悲哀はかぎりない。一方で冷泉帝はふとしたことからみずからの出生の秘密を知り、実の父である源氏を皇位につけようとするが、源氏はこれを諌め、秘密を守りつづける。
gendaibun: 明石の姫君が源氏のもとへ引きとられ、大堰の別邸では親子の悲しい別れが繰り広げられる。翌年の春、藤壺が崩御し、源氏の悲哀はかぎりない。一方で冷泉帝はふとしたことからみずからの出生の秘密を知り、実の父である源氏を皇位につけようとするが、源氏はこれを諌め、秘密を守りつづける。
gendaibunen: The Akashi daughter is brought to Genji; mother and child part in tears at the Ōi villa. The next spring Fujitsubo dies, and Genji's sorrow is endless. Reizei meanwhile learns the secret of his birth. …
kobun: 明石の姫君、源氏の君のもとに引きとられ、大堰にて親子の悲しい別れあり。翌年の春、藤壺崩御したまひて、源氏の君の悲哀かぎりなし。……
kobunen: The Akashi princess was taken into Genji's household, and at the Ōi villa a sorrowful parting of mother and child unfolded; the next spring Fujitsubo passed away, and Genji's grief knew no bounds. …

scene.content: 迎えの車を寄せたところに明石の君自ら姫君を抱いて出る。同行する乳母ら、守り刀などを車に入れさせる。
scene.contenten: When the carriage is brought up, Lady Akashi herself comes out bearing the princess; the accompanying nurse has the guardian sword and such placed in the carriage.

scene.content: 大堰への出がけに、紫の上のところに寄った源氏の裾に姫君、無邪気にまつわりつく。
scene.contenten: As he sets out for Oi, Genji stops by Murasaki's, and the princess innocently clings to his robe.

scene.content: 源氏、藤壺女院の死を悲しみ、ひとり念誦堂に籠もって夕陽を眺め、物思いに耽ける。
scene.contenten: Genji grieves Fujitsubo's death, cloisters alone in the invocation hall, watches the setting sun, and broods.

scene.content: 二条院に里帰りした斎宮女御、秋雨の庭を見る。 源氏、柱により几帳を隔てて語り合う。
scene.contenten: The Saiin Princess, returned to Nijo-in, views the autumn-rain garden; Genji talks with her through a curtain by a pillar.

scene.content: 嵯峨の念仏にかこつけて大堰に明石の君を訪れた源氏、篝火の見え隠れする大堰川の風情を眺め、悲しむ明石の君を慰める。
scene.contenten: On the pretext of nembutsu at Saga, Genji visits Lady Akashi at Oi, views the Oi River with bonfires appearing and vanishing, and comforts the grieving lady.

summaryen: Akashi's daughter is brought to Genji, and at the Oi villa a sad parting between parent and child unfolds. The following spring, Fujitsubo passes away, and Genji's grief is boundless. Meanwhile Emperor Reizei, by chance learning the secret of his birth, tries to place his true father Genji on the throne, but Genji remonstrates and continues to guard the secret.

title: 朝顔
summary: かつて源氏が深い思いを寄せていた朝顔の斎院が退下する。世人の噂が高いために、紫の上は不安の色を隠せなかったが、朝顔は源氏の求婚を拒み通す。源氏は紫の上に女君たちのことを語るが、その夜夢に藤壺が現れ、罪が知れたと言って源氏を恨む。
gendaibun: かつて源氏が深い思いを寄せていた朝顔の斎院が退下する。世人の噂が高いために、紫の上は不安の色を隠せなかったが、朝顔は源氏の求婚を拒み通す。源氏は紫の上に女君たちのことを語るが、その夜夢に藤壺が現れ、罪が知れたと言って源氏を恨む。
gendaibunen: The Asagao Priestess retires from her shrine. Worldly rumor troubles Murasaki, yet Asagao rejects Genji's proposals. That night Fujitsubo's spirit appears in Genji's dream, speaking of their sin. …
kobun: 朝顔の斎院、退下したまふ。世人の噂高く、紫の上安からず思しけれど、朝顔は源氏の求婚を拒み通したまひけり。……
kobunen: The Asagao Priestess, to whom Genji had once given his deepest thoughts, stepped down from office; rumors ran high, and though Murasaki could not hide her unease, Asagao refused Genji's suit to the end. …

scene.content: 朝顔邸より帰った源氏、 朝霧の庭を眺め、咲き残る朝顔に歌を添え、姫君に贈る。
scene.contenten: Returning from the Asagao residence, Genji views the misty morning garden, adds a poem to the lingering morning glories, and sends it to the princess.

scene.content: 源氏の文に返事を書くようにと侍女たち、朝顔の姫君に硯を勧める。
scene.contenten: Ladies urge the Princess Asagao to take up the inkstone to answer Genji's letter.

scene.content: 源氏、朝顔邸の門に車を寄せ、門番の老翁、錆びた錠を開け惑う。
scene.contenten: Genji draws his carriage to the gate of the Asagao residence; an old gatekeeper fumbles to open the rusted lock.

scene.content: 源氏、女房らに御簾を巻き上げさせ、雪の降り積もった庭にさす月光を紫の上とともにみる。
scene.contenten: Genji has the ladies raise the blinds, and he and Murasaki view moonlight on the snow-covered garden.

scene.content: 源氏と紫の上、童女たちを庭に下ろし、雪転しに興じるさまを見る。池に鴛鴦が鳴く。
scene.contenten: Genji and Murasaki let the girls down into the garden and watch them enjoy snowballing; mandarin ducks call on the pond.

summaryen: The Asagao Priestess, to whom Genji once devoted deep feelings, leaves her office. Because of the talk among people, Murasaki no Ue cannot hide her unease, but Asagao persists in refusing Genji's suit. Genji tells Murasaki no Ue about the ladies, but that night Fujitsubo appears in a dream and reproaches him, saying the sin has been discovered.

title: 少女
summary: 葵の上との子・夕霧が元服する。源氏は思うところあって、彼を大学に学ばせるが、貴顕の子弟として夕霧はこれを恥じる。恋仲の幼馴染・雲居雁の父はかつての頭中将であるが、今や内大臣であり源氏の政敵として、彼女との仲を塞えており、夕霧は鬱々とする。翌々年、源氏の邸宅・六条院が完成する。院は四季の町に分けられており、春に紫の上、夏に花散里やその他の人びと、秋は斎宮女御の宿下りの町（このために秋好中宮と呼ばれる）、冬に明石の上が住まいする。末尾に、紫の上と秋好中宮の春秋の争い歌がある。
gendaibun: 葵の上との子・夕霧が元服する。源氏は思うところあって、彼を大学に学ばせるが、貴顕の子弟として夕霧はこれを恥じる。恋仲の幼馴染・雲居雁の父はかつての頭中将であるが、今や内大臣であり源氏の政敵として、彼女との仲を塞えており、夕霧は鬱々とする。翌々年、源氏の邸宅・六条院が完成する。……
gendaibunen: Yūgiri, Genji's son by Aoi, comes of age. Genji has him study at the university, which the young noble finds humiliating. His childhood love Kumoinokari is daughter of Tō no Chūjō—now Minister of the Interior and Genji's rival. …
kobun: 葵の上の御子・夕霧、元服したまふ。源氏の君、思ふところありて大学に学ばせ給へど、貴顕の子弟として夕霧はこれを恥ぢたまふ。……
kobunen: Yūgiri, Genji's son by Aoi, came of age; Genji, with thoughts of his own, sent him to the university—a path a young noble found hard to bear with pride. …

scene.content: 夕霧 雲居雁を訪ねるが内大臣の命により襖は閉ざされていて会えない。 襖に寄りかかっていると内にいる雲居雁の独り言が聞こえる。
scene.contenten: Yugiri visits Kumoi no Kari, but by the Naidaijin's order the sliding doors are shut and they cannot meet; leaning on the door he hears Kumoi no Kari talking to herself inside.

scene.content: 五節の舞姫を務める惟光の娘に付き添う童女を選び出すため、源氏はとりどりに美しい女童たちを御前に渡らせてみる。
scene.contenten: To choose the girls to attend Koremitsu's daughter dancing the Gosechi, Genji has girls of various beauty presented before him.

scene.content: 惟光の息子、 夕霧よりの文を舞姫を務めた妹に渡す。 兄妹で文を読むところを惟光に見つかり、兄は逃げ出す。
scene.contenten: Koremitsu's son delivers a letter from Yugiri to his sister who danced; Koremitsu catches the siblings reading it and the brother runs off.

scene.content: 六条院で、秋好中宮、箱の蓋に秋の花・紅葉を載せ、美しい童女に持たせて、紫の上に贈る。
scene.contenten: At Rokujo-in, Empress Akikonomu places autumn flowers and colored leaves on a box lid and sends them with a beautiful girl to Murasaki.

summaryen: Yugiri, the son of Lady Aoi, comes of age. For his own reasons Genji has him study at the university, and as a scion of the high nobility Yugiri is ashamed of this. His childhood sweetheart Kumoi no Kari's father is the former Head Chamberlain, now Naidaijin and Genji's political rival, who blocks their match, and Yugiri broods. Two years later, Genji's residence, the Rokujo-in, is completed. The compound is divided into seasonal wards: Murasaki no Ue in spring, Hanachirusato and others in summer, the Priestess Consort's ward (for which she is called Akikonomu, the lover of autumn) in autumn, and Lady Akashi in winter. At the end there is a poem contest between spring and autumn by Murasaki no Ue and Akikonomu.

title: 玉鬘
summary: 夕顔の死により、玉鬘は乳母に連れられて大宰府へ移り、美しく成人する。父・内大臣に一目逢わせたいと願う乳母と共に初瀬に参籠した折、かつての夕顔から今は源氏に仕えていた女房・右近と偶然めぐり逢い、源氏に養女として引き取られる。
gendaibun: 夕顔の死により、玉鬘は乳母に連れられて大宰府へ移り、美しく成人する。父・内大臣に一目逢わせたいと願う乳母と共に初瀬に参籠した折、かつての夕顔から今は源氏に仕えていた女房・右近と偶然めぐり逢い、源氏に養女として引き取られる。
gendaibunen: After Yūgao's death, Tamakazura is raised in Dazaifu. Hoping to reunite her with her father, her nurse takes her to Hatsuse; by chance they meet Ukon, once Yūgao's attendant and now in Genji's service, and Genji takes Tamakazura into his care. …
kobun: 夕顔の死後、玉鬘は乳母に連れられて大宰府へ移り、美しく成人したまふ。初瀬に参籠の折、右近とめぐり逢ひて、源氏の君の養女となりたまひける。……
kobunen: After Yūgao's death, Tamakazura was taken by her nurse to Dazaifu and grew into beauty; wishing only to show her once to her father, they came to pray at Hatsuse—and there met an old companion of Yūgao's now serving Genji. …

scene.content: 玉鬘、 求婚者より逃れ、早船に乗って上洛。
scene.contenten: Tamakazura escapes her suitors and travels up to the capital on a fast boat.

scene.content: 秋の初瀬に詣でた右近、同宿の人々の中に顔見知りの女を認め、呼び出して、玉鬘一行と知る。弓を持つ男等同行している。
scene.contenten: Ukon, visiting Hatsuse in autumn, recognizes a familiar woman among her fellow lodgers, calls her out, and learns it is Tamakazura's party; men with bows accompany them.

scene.content: 初瀬参詣の玉鬘、右近に再会し、高台にある宿坊で積もる話をして過ごす。下の御堂に参詣する人、多数。
scene.contenten: Tamakazura, on pilgrimage to Hatsuse, is reunited with Ukon, and they spend the time talking in an elevated lodging; many people visit the lower hall.

scene.content: 六条院の西の対に引き取られた玉鬘のもと、夜になってから訪れる源氏。右近、妻戸を開いて迎え入れる。
scene.contenten: Genji visits Tamakazura, taken in at the west wing of Rokujo-in, after nightfall; Ukon opens the door to welcome him.

scene.content: 源氏、几帳を押しやり初めて玉鬘を見る。 右近、灯火をかきあげて近くに寄せる。
scene.contenten: Genji pushes aside the screen and sees Tamakazura for the first time; Ukon lifts the lamp and brings it near.

scene.content: 歳の暮れ、源氏と紫の上、とりどりの衣裳を婦人たちに配るため、 選び整える。
scene.contenten: At year's end Genji and Murasaki sort and arrange robes to distribute to the ladies.

summaryen: Because of Yugao's death, Tamakazura is taken by her nurse to Dazaifu and grows into a beautiful woman. Worshipping at Hatsuse with the nurse, who longs to let her meet her father the Naidaijin, she chances upon Ukon, once a lady-in-waiting of Yugao and now in Genji's service, and is adopted by Genji.

title: 初音
summary: 年明けて六条院の優雅な初春の情景が描かれる。しかし源氏の元に年賀に来る若公達は、玉鬘の噂に気もそぞろである。
gendaibun: 年明けて六条院の優雅な初春の情景が描かれる。しかし源氏の元に年賀に来る若公達は、玉鬘の噂に気もそぞろである。
gendaibunen: At New Year the Rokujō mansion is filled with graceful spring scenes. Young nobles who come to pay Genji their respects can think of little but rumors of Tamakazura. …
kobun: 年明けて六条院の優雅なる初春のさま。源氏の君のもとに年賀に参る若公達は、玉鬘の噂に心もそぞろなり。……
kobunen: With the New Year, elegant scenes of early spring unfolded at Rokujō-in; yet the young nobles who came to offer greetings to Genji had their minds already elsewhere—on rumors of Tamakazura. …

scene.content: 六条院の正月、源氏、紫の上と鏡餅の祝いをする。
scene.contenten: At the New Year at Rokujo-in, Genji celebrates with Murasaki over mirror mochi.

scene.content: 明石の君より鶯をつけた五葉松を飾った髭籠につけて明石の姫君に贈られた手紙を源氏見る。 子の日なので、女童たち、庭で小松を引く。
scene.contenten: Genji sees the letter sent to the Akashi Princess, attached to a basket decorated with a five-needle pine and a warbler, from Lady Akashi; as it is the day of the rat, the girls pull young pines in the garden.

scene.content: 源氏、明石の君のもとを訪れ、琴などの置かれた室内で手習い反古を見て、自らも筆をとって書いてみるところへ、明石の君いざり出る。
scene.contenten: Genji visits Lady Akashi and, in a room with kotos and such, examines old practice papers and takes up a brush himself, when Lady Akashi comes crawling out.

scene.content: 男踏歌の翌日、源氏、みごとな袋に収めてあった琴を数多く取り出して、調弦し、婦人たちを集めて内々の後宴をしようと考える。
scene.contenten: The day after the men's toka, Genji takes out many fine kotos kept in splendid bags, tunes them, and plans a private after-feast for the ladies.

summaryen: With the new year, the graceful early-spring scenes of the Rokujo-in are depicted. But the young noblemen who come to pay New Year's greetings to Genji have their hearts set on the rumors of Tamakazura.

title: 胡蝶
summary: 三月、秋好中宮の宿下りにあわせて六条院では船遊びが行われ、その後もさまざまな行事が続く。玉鬘のあまりの魅力に、源氏までが冗談めいた思いを打ち明ける。
gendaibun: 三月、秋好中宮の宿下りにあわせて六条院では船遊びが行われ、その後もさまざまな行事が続く。玉鬘のあまりの魅力に、源氏までが冗談めいた思いを打ち明ける。
gendaibunen: In the Third Month, boat parties and celebrations fill Rokujō-in when the autumn consort returns. Tamakazura's beauty so moves Genji that even he half-jokingly reveals an improper feeling. …
kobun: 三月、秋好中宮の宿下りに合わせて、六条院に船遊びなどあり。玉鬘のあまりの魅力に、源氏の君まで冗談めかして思ひを打ち明けたまふ。……
kobunen: In the Third Month, timed with the autumn consort's return to her apartments, boat parties were held at Rokujō-in, and festivities continued; even Genji found himself confessing, half in jest, a feeling stirred by Tamakazura's charm. …

scene.content: 六条院で春の船楽。 花咲き誇る庭の他に龍頭鷁首の船。
scene.contenten: Spring boat music at Rokujo-in; besides the garden in full bloom, boats with dragon and bird-head prows.

scene.content: 秋好中宮の仏事に紫の上より鳥と蝶の装束をした童女を使者として、金銀の瓶に挿した桜と山吹が贈られる。
scene.contenten: For Empress Akikonomu's Buddhist service, Murasaki sends girls dressed as birds and butterflies as messengers, with cherries and kerria in gold and silver vases.

scene.content: 源氏、玉鬘のもとに届けられた文が結ばれたままなのを開いて読み、誰からのものか、右近に問う。
scene.contenten: Genji opens and reads the still-tied letter delivered to Tamakazura and asks Ukon who sent it.

scene.content: 玉鬘のもとを訪ね、言い寄った源氏、帰りぎわに御簾を引き上げ、庭の呉竹に寄せた歌を詠みかける。
scene.contenten: Visiting Tamakazura and pressing his suit, Genji on leaving lifts the blinds and recites a poem likening her to the bamboo in the garden.

scene.content: 夕暮れ、源氏、玉鬘のもとで、箱の蓋に菓子とともに盛られた橘の実をもてあそびながら、愛を打ち明けた歌を詠む。
scene.contenten: At dusk at Tamakazura's, Genji toys with tangerines piled with sweets on a box lid and recites a poem revealing his love.

summaryen: In the third month, a boat excursion is held at the Rokujo-in to mark Akikonomu's return home, and various events follow. Tamakazura's overwhelming charm leads even Genji to voice a joking fondness.

title: 蛍
summary: 玉鬘は鬱々として楽しまないが、源氏は彼女に好意を持つ公達をからかって楽しむ。弟・兵部卿宮が来訪すると、源氏は御簾の中に蛍を放って、玉鬘の美貌を彼に見せつける。六条院では五月雨のつれづれに絵物語がはやり、源氏と玉鬘が物語論を交わす。
gendaibun: 玉鬘は鬱々として楽しまないが、源氏は彼女に好意を持つ公達をからかって楽しむ。弟・兵部卿宮が来訪すると、源氏は御簾の中に蛍を放って、玉鬘の美貌を彼に見せつける。六条院では五月雨のつれづれに絵物語がはやり、源氏と玉鬘が物語論を交わす。
gendaibunen: Tamakazura is unhappy; Genji toys with her suitors. When his brother visits, Genji releases fireflies behind the blinds to display her beauty. In the rainy season, illustrated tales become the fashion at Rokujō-in. …
kobun: 玉鬘は鬱々として楽しまず、源氏の君は彼女に好意を寄せる公達をからかひて楽しむ。蛍を御簾のうちに放ちて、その美貌を見せたまひける。……
kobunen: Tamakazura took little pleasure in her days, while Genji amused himself by teasing the young nobles who admired her; when his brother the Minister of War visited, Genji released fireflies beneath the blinds to show him her beauty. …

scene.content: 螢兵部卿宮、玉鬘を訪ね、 源氏が几帳の帷子を上げて放った螢の光に玉鬘の美しい姿を見る。
scene.contenten: Hotaru Hyobukyo no Miya visits Tamakazura, and by the light of fireflies Genji releases after raising the curtain, sees her beautiful figure.

scene.content: 玉鬘のもとに螢兵部卿宮より菖蒲の根に結び付けて文が届く。 これを見た源氏は返事を書くように勧める。
scene.contenten: From Hotaru Hyobukyo no Miya a letter tied to an iris root arrives for Tamakazura; Genji, seeing it, urges her to write a reply.

scene.content: 六条院馬場大殿で競射。 廊の戸口に御簾を掛け人々見物。
scene.contenten: An archery contest at the Rokujo-in riding ground; blinds hung at the corridor doorway as people watch.

scene.content: 源氏、紫の上がくまの、物語の絵など見ているところに来合わせ、明石の姫君が読む物語について配慮するように注意する。
scene.contenten: Genji comes upon Murasaki looking at pictures such as The Bear of Kumano, and warns her to be mindful of the tales the Akashi Princess reads.

summaryen: Tamakazura is melancholy and joyless, but Genji amuses himself teasing the noblemen who fancy her. When her half-brother, the Hyobukyo Prince, visits, Genji releases fireflies inside the blinds to show off Tamakazura's beauty to him. At the Rokujo-in, illustrated romances are in fashion during the tedium of the rainy season, and Genji and Tamakazura discuss the theory of tales.

title: 常夏
summary: 夏のある日、源氏は夕霧や若公達を招き、内大臣が玉鬘に対抗して最近引き取った娘・近江の君の悪趣味や無風流を揶揄し、その後撫子（常夏）の咲き乱れる御殿に玉鬘を訪ねる。
gendaibun: 夏のある日、源氏は夕霧や若公達を招き、内大臣が玉鬘に対抗して最近引き取った娘・近江の君の悪趣味や無風流を揶揄し、その後撫子（常夏）の咲き乱れる御殿に玉鬘を訪ねる。
gendaibunen: One summer day Genji invites Yūgiri and young nobles, ridicules the tasteless Lady of Ōmi whom the Minister has recently taken in as a rival to Tamakazura, then visits Tamakazura among halls of blooming pinks (tokonatsu). …
kobun: 夏のある日、源氏の君、夕霧らを招き、近江の君の無風流を揶揄したまひて後、撫子（常夏）の咲き乱るる殿に玉鬘を訪ひたまふ。……
kobunen: On a summer day Genji invited Yūgiri and other young nobles, mocked the vulgar tastes of the Minister of the Interior's newly adopted daughter—the Lady of Ōmi—and afterward visited Tamakazura in halls bright with blooming pinks. …

scene.content: 夏の暑い日、源氏、釣殿で涼をとり、川魚など料理させて、内大臣の子息たちと歓談する。
scene.contenten: On a hot summer day Genji cools off at the fishing pavilion, has river fish prepared, and chats with the Naidaijin's sons.

scene.content: 夕方、源氏、玉鬘を訪ね、貴公子たちも同行。前栽に撫子咲き乱れる。
scene.contenten: In the evening Genji visits Tamakazura, accompanied by young noblemen; pink flowers bloom profusely in the garden.

scene.content: 月のない夜、篝火をたかせ、源氏は玉鬘に琴を教える。玉鬘への恋慕つのる。
scene.contenten: On a moonless night, with bonfires lit, Genji teaches Tamakazura the koto; his longing for her grows.

scene.content: 暑い日、雲居雁が手枕をしてうたた寝する姿を見た内大臣、起こして諫める。
scene.contenten: On a hot day the Naidaijin sees Kumoi no Kari napping on her arm and wakes her to admonish her.

scene.content: 近江の君が五節の君と双六をするところを内大臣覗く。
scene.contenten: The Naidaijin peeks at Lady Omi playing sugoroku with Gosechi no Kimi.

summaryen: One summer day Genji invites Yugiri and the young noblemen, mocks the vulgarity and want of taste of Lady Omi, the daughter the Naidaijin recently took in to rival Tamakazura, and then visits Tamakazura in a hall where wild pinks (tokonatsu) bloom in profusion.

title: 篝火
summary: 秋のはじめのある夜、源氏は玉鬘に琴を教え、庭に篝火を焚かせて添臥する。しかし男女の関係にはならない。
gendaibun: 秋のはじめのある夜、源氏は玉鬘に琴を教え、庭に篝火を焚かせて添臥する。しかし男女の関係にはならない。
gendaibunen: Early in autumn Genji teaches Tamakazura the koto and has brushwood fires lit in the garden as they rest side by side—but they do not become lovers. …
kobun: 秋の初めのある夜、源氏の君、玉鬘に琴を教へ、庭に篝火を焚かせて添ひ臥したまふ。されど男女の関係には至らず。……
kobunen: Early one autumn night Genji taught Tamakazura the koto and had brushwood fires lit in the garden as they lay side by side—yet they did not become lovers. …

scene.content: 夏の夕、源氏、琴を枕に玉鬘に添い乱し、池畔の燃え立つ篝火を見て歌を交わす。
scene.contenten: On a summer evening Genji lies beside Tamakazura using a koto as a pillow, and they exchange poems while watching bonfires blaze by the pond.

scene.content: その折、花散里の東の対から夕霧や柏木らの合奏が聞こえてくる。
scene.contenten: At that time, from Hanachirusato's east wing comes the ensemble of Yugiri, Kashiwagi, and others.

scene.content: 源氏、夕霧・柏木らを玉鬘の方に招き、合奏。源氏は琴を弾く。 御簾の奥に玉鬘。
scene.contenten: Genji invites Yugiri, Kashiwagi, and others to Tamakazura's side for an ensemble; Genji plays the koto, with Tamakazura behind the blinds.

summaryen: On an early autumn night, Genji teaches Tamakazura the koto and, with bonfires lit in the garden, lies down beside her. But they do not become lovers.

title: 野分
summary: 野分（台風）の翌朝、夕霧は源氏の妻妾を見舞いに六条院に行き、偶然紫の上を見て心を惹かれる。また玉鬘に戯れる父の姿に、不審を抱く。
gendaibun: 野分（台風）の翌朝、夕霧は源氏の妻妾を見舞いに六条院に行き、偶然紫の上を見て心を惹かれる。また玉鬘に戯れる父の姿に、不審を抱く。
gendaibunen: The morning after a typhoon, Yūgiri visits Rokujō-in to check on Genji's ladies. He glimpses Murasaki and is drawn to her; seeing his father toy with Tamakazura also fills him with suspicion. …
kobun: 野分の翌朝、夕霧、六条院に見舞ひに参りて、偶然紫の上を見たてまつり心ひかれ、また玉鬘に戯るる父の姿に不審を抱きたまふ。……
kobunen: On the morning after a typhoon, Yūgiri went to Rokujō-in to inquire after Genji's ladies and by chance glimpsed Murasaki—his heart was stirred—and he also saw his father sporting with Tamakazura, which left him uneasy. …

scene.content: 夕霧、野分の風に吹き上げられた御簾を押さえる女房たちを見て微笑む紫の上を垣間見る。
scene.contenten: Yugiri glimpses Murasaki smiling as she watches the ladies hold down blinds blown up by the autumn gale.

scene.content: 野分の翌朝、夕霧は父の使いで秋好中宮を訪問。女童たちが朝霧の庭に下りて虫籠に露を含ませるところを覗き見る。
scene.contenten: The morning after the gale, Yugiri visits Empress Akikonomu on his father's errand; he peeks as girls go into the misty garden and wet the insect cages with dew.

scene.content: 源氏、明るい朝の光の中で玉鬘を引き寄せ戯れる。夕霧はこれを見て驚く。
scene.contenten: Genji draws Tamakazura to him and dallies in the bright morning light; Yugiri is startled to see this.

scene.content: 夕霧、明石の姫君のもとで、女房に料紙をもらい雲居雁へ手紙を書く。
scene.contenten: At the Akashi Princess's, Yugiri gets paper from a lady and writes a letter to Kumoi no Kari.

summaryen: On the morning after a typhoon, Yugiri goes to the Rokujo-in to inquire after Genji's wives and ladies, and catching sight of Murasaki no Ue by chance, is drawn to her. He also feels suspicion at the sight of his father dallying with Tamakazura.

title: 行幸
summary: 冬、大原野の行幸で玉鬘に執心する冷泉帝を垣間見た彼女も、にくからず思う。源氏は内大臣に真相を打ち明け、入内に向けてまずは玉鬘の裳着（古代女性の成年式）を行うことを話し合う。年明けて春、玉鬘は裳着を行い、内大臣と親子の対面を果たす。
gendaibun: 冬、大原野の行幸で玉鬘に執心する冷泉帝を垣間見た彼女も、にくからず思う。源氏は内大臣に真相を打ち明け、入内に向けてまずは玉鬘の裳着（古代女性の成年式）を行うことを話し合う。年明けて春、玉鬘は裳着を行い、内大臣と親子の対面を果たす。
gendaibunen: In winter, during an imperial outing to Ōhara-no, Tamakazura glimpses Emperor Reizei, who desires her, and does not dislike him. Genji tells the Minister the truth and discusses her coming-of-age rite before she enters palace service. …
kobun: 冬、大原野の行幸にて、玉鬘に執心したまふ冷泉帝を垣間見て、彼女もにくからず思ふ。源氏の君、内大臣に真相を打ち明きたまひける。……
kobunen: In winter, at the imperial progress to Ōhara-no, Tamakazura caught sight of Emperor Reizei—who longed for her—and did not find him unpleasing; Genji then spoke frankly with the Minister about presenting her at court. …

scene.content: 冬の大原野へ行幸。 主上の鳳輦に、親王・上達部ら多数が鷹狩姿で供奉。鷹匠も従う。
scene.contenten: A winter imperial visit to Oharano; many princes and high nobles in hawking dress attend the Emperor's palanquin, along with falconers.

scene.content: 鷹狩り不参の源氏に、帝より枝につけた唯一対が贈られる。
scene.contenten: To Genji, who did not join the hawking, the Emperor sends a pair of fish attached to a branch.

scene.content: 玉鬘の裳着にあたって諸方より祝い物届く。末摘花よりの古風な祝いに添えられた歌を見て源氏赤面する。
scene.contenten: Gifts of congratulation arrive from many quarters for Tamakazura's initiation; seeing the poem attached to Suetsumuhana's old-fashioned gift, Genji blushes.

summaryen: In winter, having glimpsed Emperor Reizei, who is taken with Tamakazura, at the imperial progress to Ohara, she too finds him not unappealing. Genji reveals the truth to the Naidaijin, and they discuss first holding Tamakazura's mogi, the coming-of-age ceremony for women, before her entry to court. With the new year, Tamakazura performs her mogi and meets her father the Naidaijin.

title: 藤袴
summary: 秋、内大臣の母・大宮が物故し、孫にあたる夕霧や玉鬘らは服喪する。玉鬘入内の噂が高くなるにつれて求婚者たちの思いは乱れ、玉鬘の出自を知った夕霧も藤袴一枝を御簾に差入れて彼女に意中をあかす。
gendaibun: 秋、内大臣の母・大宮が物故し、孫にあたる夕霧や玉鬘らは服喪する。玉鬘入内の噂が高くなるにつれて求婚者たちの思いは乱れ、玉鬘の出自を知った夕霧も藤袴一枝を御簾に差入れて彼女に意中をあかす。
gendaibunen: In autumn the Minister's mother dies; Yūgiri and Tamakazura mourn. Rumors of Tamakazura's palace entry agitate her suitors. Yūgiri, now knowing her parentage, places a branch of fujibakama in her blinds to reveal his feelings. …
kobun: 秋、内大臣の母・大宮物故し、夕霧・玉鬘ら服喪す。玉鬘入内の噂高くなるにつれ、夕霧も藤袴一枝を御簾に差し入れて意中をあかす。……
kobunen: In autumn the Minister's mother, the Ōmiya, passed away; Yūgiri and Tamakazura, her grandchildren, went into mourning. As talk of Tamakazura's entry to court grew louder, suitors' hearts grew wild—and Yūgiri, learning her birth, set a spray of purple trousers in her blinds to declare himself. …

scene.content: 夕霧、源氏の使いで玉鬘を訪ね、藤袴の花を御簾より差し入れて、求愛する。二人ともに喪服姿。
scene.contenten: Yugiri visits Tamakazura on Genji's errand, offers her a purple winter cherry from behind the blinds, and courts her; both are in mourning.

scene.content: 出仕まぢかの玉鬘のもとに諸方より懸想の文が届くが、玉鬘は見ようともしない。螢兵部卿宮よりも霜を置いた笹の枝につけた文が届く。
scene.contenten: Suitors' letters arrive for Tamakazura, soon to enter court service, but she will not look at them; from Hotaru Hyobukyo no Miya comes a letter on a frost-covered bamboo branch.

summaryen: In autumn the Naidaijin's mother, Omiya, dies, and her grandchildren Yugiri and Tamakazura go into mourning. As rumors of Tamakazura's entry to court grow, her suitors' feelings are thrown into disorder, and Yugiri, learning of her parentage, slips a spray of fujibakama through the blinds and confesses his love.

title: 真木柱
summary: 秋の末、かねてより玉鬘に思いをかけていた髭黒大将が女房の手引きにより、玉鬘と強引に関係を持つ。源氏や冷泉帝の落胆は言うまでもない。玉鬘に夢中の髭黒はもとの北の方や彼女との子供たちをまったく顧みず、怒った舅・式部卿宮は娘と孫を引き取ると決める。姫君は父との別れを悲しんで歌を詠み、真木の柱の割目に挟んで残す。翌年の秋、玉鬘は髭黒の子を生む。
gendaibun: 秋の末、かねてより玉鬘に思いをかけていた髭黒大将が女房の手引きにより、玉鬘と強引に関係を持つ。源氏や冷泉帝の落胆は言うまでもない。玉鬘に夢中の髭黒はもとの北の方や彼女との子供たちをまったく顧みず、怒った舅・式部卿宮は娘と孫を引き取ると決める。姫君は父との別れを悲しんで歌を詠み、真木の柱の割目に挟んで残す。……
gendaibunen: Late in autumn Higekuro, long in love with Tamakazura, forces an intimacy with a lady-in-waiting's help. Genji and Reizei are crushed. Obsessed, Higekuro neglects his first wife and children until she leaves in anger, taking the children and the “true-wood pillar.” …
kobun: 秋の末、髭黒大将、女房の手引きにより玉鬘と強引に逢ひたまふ。源氏の君・冷泉帝の落胆いうまでもなし。……
kobunen: Late in autumn, Higekuro—who had long desired Tamakazura—forced his way to her with a gentlewoman's help; the disappointment of Genji and Emperor Reizei need hardly be told. …

scene.content: 心ならずも鬚黒右大将の妻となってしまい、不機嫌な日々を送る玉鬘のもとを、源氏、大将の留守中に訪れる。 玉鬘、几帳に身を隠し、源氏は脇息によって覗く。
scene.contenten: Genji visits Tamakazura, unhappy at having unwillingly become General Higekuro's wife, while the General is away; she hides behind a screen and Genji peers over an armrest.

scene.content: 雪の夜、玉鬘のもとに通う鬚黒大将を身づくろいさせた北の方、突然、大将に火取りを投げかける。
scene.contenten: On a snowy night the principal wife, having dressed Higekuro for his visit to Tamakazura, suddenly throws a fire pan at him.

scene.content: 冬の夕、母とともに家を去ろうとする鬚黒の姫君(真木柱)、歌を書いた紙を柱の割れ目に差し入れ残しおく。
scene.contenten: On a winter evening Higekuro's daughter (Makibashira), about to leave home with her mother, slips a poem written on paper into a crack in a pillar.

scene.content: 玉鬘の去ったあと、主なき西の対に立ち寄った源氏、山吹の咲く春の庭を見て、玉鬘を想う。
scene.contenten: After Tamakazura leaves, Genji stops at the masterless west wing and, seeing the spring garden with blooming kerria, longs for her.

summaryen: At the end of autumn, the Higekuro General, who had long desired Tamakazura, forces himself on her with the aid of a lady-in-waiting. The dismay of Genji and Emperor Reizei needs no telling. Higekuro, infatuated with Tamakazura, pays no heed to his former wife or their children, and the angry father-in-law, the Shikibukyo Prince, resolves to take his daughter and grandchildren back. The daughter grieves at parting from her father and, composing a poem, leaves it wedged in the split of a true-wood pillar. In autumn of the following year, Tamakazura bears Higekuro's child.

title: 梅枝
summary: 明石の姫君の入内が近づき、源氏は贅を尽くした準備を整える。その一環として名香の調合がひろく諸家に呼びかけられ、梅の咲く春のある日薫物合が行われる。晩春、明石の姫君の裳着が盛大に行われる。
gendaibun: 明石の姫君の入内が近づき、源氏は贅を尽くした準備を整える。その一環として名香の調合がひろく諸家に呼びかけられ、梅の咲く春のある日薫物合が行われる。晩春、明石の姫君の裳着が盛大に行われる。
gendaibunen: As the Akashi daughter's entry to court approaches, Genji spares no expense. Houses are invited to blend fine incense; on a plum-blossom spring day an incense contest is held, and later her coming-of-age rite is celebrated in grandeur. …
kobun: 明石の姫君の入内近づき、源氏の君、贅を尽くしたる用意を整ふ。梅の咲く春の日、薫物合せありて、裳着も盛大に行われける。……
kobunen: As the Akashi princess's entry to court drew near, Genji prepared with every luxury; houses were called to blend famous incense, and one spring day of plum blossom an incense contest was held. …

scene.content: 朝顔の斎院より源氏のもとに、紺と白の瑠璃の壺にいれた薫物が松と梅の枝をつけて贈られる。螢兵部卿宮、艶なさまに感嘆。
scene.contenten: From the Asagao Saiin, incense in dark blue and white lapis vases, with pine and plum branches, is sent to Genji; Hotaru Hyobukyo no Miya admires the elegance.

scene.content: 源氏、朝顔の斎院への返事の文を紅梅の紙に書き、庭前の梅の枝につけて贈る。
scene.contenten: Genji writes a reply to the Asagao Saiin on crimson plum paper and sends it on a garden plum branch.

scene.content: 明石の姫君の裳着の前夜、源氏と螢兵部卿宮ら、六条院の夫人たちの調合した薫物を合わせる。
scene.contenten: On the eve of the Akashi Princess's initiation, Genji, Hotaru Hyobukyo no Miya, and others blend the incenses prepared by the ladies of Rokujo-in.

scene.content: その明け方、帰ろうとする螢兵部卿宮に源氏、直衣と薫物を贈る。
scene.contenten: At dawn, as Hotaru Hyobukyo no Miya prepares to leave, Genji gives him a noshi robe and incense.

scene.content: 姫君入内のため、源氏、寝殿で女房たちに墨をすらせて草子を書く。
scene.contenten: For the princess's entry to court, Genji has the ladies in the main hall grind ink and write booklets.

summaryen: As Akashi's daughter's entry to court approaches, Genji makes lavish preparations. As part of them, the compounding of fine incense is urged upon many houses, and on a spring day when the plums bloom a scent-comparing contest is held. In late spring, Akashi's daughter's mogi is held with great pomp.

title: 藤裏葉
summary: 夕霧と雲居雁の結婚を遂に内大臣が許し、明石の姫君は東宮（朱雀帝の子）に入内する。さらに冷泉帝は翌年が源氏四十の賀であることを知って、彼を准太上天皇に進める旨を勅する。冬、冷泉帝が六条院に行幸し、源氏の栄華はここに極まる。少年の日、高麗の人相見が彼に告げた「その身は帝王にあらず、臣下にあらず」という予言は的中する。
gendaibun: 夕霧と雲居雁の結婚を遂に内大臣が許し、明石の姫君は東宮（朱雀帝の子）に入内する。さらに冷泉帝は翌年が源氏四十の賀であることを知って、彼を准太上天皇に進める旨を勅する。冬、冷泉帝が六条院に行幸し、源氏の栄華はここに極まる。少年の日、高麗の人相見が彼に告げた「その身は帝王にあらず、臣下にあらず」という予言は的中する。
gendaibunen: The Minister finally permits Yūgiri's marriage to Kumoinokari; the Akashi daughter enters the Crown Prince's household. Reizei, noting Genji's coming fortieth year, raises him toward the rank of a retired emperor; in winter the emperor visits Rokujō-in. …
kobun: 夕霧と雲居雁の結婚、内大臣ようやく許し、明石の姫君は東宮に入内したまふ。冷泉帝、源氏の君を准太上天皇に進めむ旨を勅したまひける。……
kobunen: At last the Minister allowed Yūgiri to marry Kumoinokari; the Akashi princess entered the household of the Crown Prince, and learning that the next year would mark Genji's fortieth, Emperor Reizei announced he would raise Genji to quasi-retired-emperor rank. …

scene.content: 内大臣、 藤花の宴に夕霧を招き、杯に藤の花房を添えて、雲居雁を許す歌を詠む。柏木ら同席する。
scene.contenten: The Naidaijin invites Yugiri to a wisteria banquet, adds a wisteria spray to a cup, and recites a poem granting him Kumoi no Kari; Kashiwagi and others attend.

scene.content: 夕霧より雲居雁のもとに届いた後朝の文を内大臣読む。
scene.contenten: The Naidaijin reads the letter to Kumoi no Kari that Yugiri had delivered.

scene.content: 三条殿に移った新婚の夕霧・雲居雁が、 大宮を偲んでいるところへ庭の紅葉の美しさに引かれて、父太政大臣が訪れる。
scene.contenten: To the newlywed Yugiri and Kumoi no Kari, moved to Sanjo Palace, the father Daijo Daijin visits, drawn by the beauty of the garden's colored leaves as they long for the Omiya.

scene.content: 紅葉の六条院に行幸。反橋・渡殿に錦を敷き、東の池では鵜飼。
scene.contenten: An imperial visit to the autumn-leaves Rokujo-in; brocade is spread on the arched bridge and gallery, and cormorant fishing is shown on the east pond.

summaryen: The Naidaijin at last permits the marriage of Yugiri and Kumoi no Kari, and Akashi's daughter enters the court of the Crown Prince, Emperor Suzaku's son. Further, Emperor Reizei, learning that the following year will be Genji's fortieth, decrees his promotion to Junior Retired Emperor. In winter Emperor Reizei makes a progress to the Rokujo-in, and Genji's glory reaches its height. The prophecy of the Korean physiognomist from his boyhood, that his person was neither sovereign nor subject, comes true.

title: 若菜上
summary: 源氏の四十歳を祝い、正月に玉鬘が若菜を献じる。一方で朱雀院は出家に際して末娘女三宮の行末を案じ、これを源氏に嫁がせる。紫の上の憂慮はひとかたならず、源氏自身もほんの少女にすぎない彼女に対して愛情を感じられないが、兄帝の皇女を無下には扱えない。秋、源氏四十の賀が盛大に行われる。さらに翌年の春には明石女御が東宮の子を出産し、源氏の権勢はいよいよ高まりつつあるが、その陰で、六条院の蹴鞠の催しに女三の宮を垣間見た内大臣の子息・柏木は彼女へのひそかな思慕をつのらせる。
gendaibun: 源氏の四十歳を祝い、正月に玉鬘が若菜を献じる。一方で朱雀院は出家に際して末娘女三宮の行末を案じ、これを源氏に嫁がせる。紫の上の憂慮はひとかたならず、源氏自身もほんの少女にすぎない彼女に対して愛情を感じられないが、兄帝の皇女を無下には扱えない。秋、源氏四十の賀が盛大に行われる。……
gendaibunen: At New Year Tamakazura offers young herbs for Genji's fortieth celebration. Retired Emperor Suzaku, preparing to take Buddhist vows, worries for his youngest—the Third Princess—and marries her to Genji. Murasaki's distress is great; Genji himself feels little true love for the girl. …
kobun: 源氏四十の賀に、玉鬘若菜を献ず。朱雀院、出家に際して女三の宮を源氏に嫁がせたまふ。紫の上の憂へ、ひとかたならず。……
kobunen: To celebrate Genji's fortieth year, Tamakazura presented young herbs at the New Year; meanwhile Retired Emperor Suzaku, about to take orders, fretted over his youngest daughter the Third Princess and gave her in marriage to Genji. …

scene.content: 源氏の四十の賀を玉、心を尽くして用意し祝う。 若菜を奉る席に玉髪の若君も同伴、歌を交わす。
scene.contenten: For Genji's fortieth-year celebration, the Waka Lady prepares and celebrates with all her heart; the young lord Wakagami accompanies the offering of young herbs, and poems are exchanged.

scene.content: 女三の宮降嫁後、紫の上楽しまず。 硯を引き寄せて歌を詠む。 源氏当惑してより臥す。
scene.contenten: After the Third Princess's marriage, Murasaki is joyless; drawing the inkstone near, she composes a poem; Genji, perplexed, lies down.

scene.content: 雪の早朝、女三の宮のもとより紫の上のもとに帰った源氏、閉められた格子を叩くが、女房たちは気付いてもしばらく開けない。
scene.contenten: On a snowy early morning Genji, returning to Murasaki from the Third Princess's, knocks at the shut lattice, but the ladies, though aware, do not open for a while.

scene.content: 雪の朝、源氏、梅の枝に文をつけて女三の宮のもとに贈る。端近で雪を見る源氏、梅には鶯、奥に紫の上。
scene.contenten: On a snowy morning Genji sends a letter attached to a plum branch to the Third Princess; Genji watches the snow near the edge, a warbler on the plum, Murasaki within.

scene.content: 源氏、朧月夜の邸を早朝に立ち出る。 藤の花が盛りの庭に網代車を寄せる。
scene.contenten: Genji leaves Oborozukiyo's residence at dawn; he draws his carriage up to the garden where wisteria is in full bloom.

scene.content: 十月、源氏の四十の賀に、紫の上は嵯峨御堂で薬師仏を供養、ついで二条院で盛大な賀宴を催す。その夜、楽人たちが褒美の白い衣を肩に掛けて、池畔を帰っていく。
scene.contenten: In the tenth month, for Genji's fortieth celebration, Murasaki offers to the Yakushi Buddha at the Saga chapel, then holds a grand feast at Nijo-in; that night the musicians go home along the pond with white reward robes on their shoulders.

scene.content: 桜の下で蹴鞠に興じる貴公子たちを見ていた女三の宮、猫が偶然に引き開けた御簾の隙間より柏木にその姿を見られる。
scene.contenten: The Third Princess, watching noble youths play kemari under the cherry blossoms, is seen by Kashiwagi through a gap in the blinds a cat happened to pull open.

summaryen: To celebrate Genji's fortieth year, Tamakazura offers young greens at the New Year. Meanwhile Emperor Suzaku, about to take the tonsure, worries over the future of his youngest daughter, Onna San no Miya, and gives her to Genji. Murasaki no Ue's anxiety is extraordinary, and Genji himself feels no love for her, little more than a girl, but cannot treat an imperial princess of his brother's house unkindly. In autumn, Genji's fortieth celebration is held with great pomp. The following spring, Lady Akashi's daughter bears a child to the Crown Prince, and Genji's power rises ever higher, but behind the scenes Kashiwagi, son of the Naidaijin, who glimpsed Onna San no Miya at a kickball gathering at the Rokujo-in, nurses a secret longing for her.

title: 若菜下
summary: 朱雀院五十の賀に際して女楽が催され、源氏は女三の宮に琴を教える。女楽の直後、紫の上が病に臥しそのときは六条御息所の死霊が物怪となって取り憑いていた、源氏はその看護に余念がない。その間に柏木は小侍従女三の宮の乳姉妹の手引きでかねてよりの思いを遂げ、その後も何度かの密会と契りを経て女三宮を懐妊させる。柏木が女三宮に送った手紙を手にして事情を知った源氏は、懊悩する。一方で源氏の遠まわしな諷諌に、柏木は恐怖のあまり病を発し、そのまま重態に陥る。
gendaibun: 朱雀院五十の賀に際して女楽が催され、源氏は女三の宮に琴を教える。女楽の直後、紫の上が病に臥しそのときは六条御息所の死霊が物怪となって取り憑いていた、源氏はその看護に余念がない。その間に柏木は小侍従女三の宮の乳姉妹の手引きでかねてよりの思いを遂げ、その後も何度かの密会と契りを経て女三宮を懐妊させる。……
gendaibunen: At Suzaku's fiftieth celebration Genji teaches the Third Princess the koto. Soon after, Murasaki falls ill, haunted by Lady Rokujō's spirit; while Genji nurses her, Kashiwagi, guided by a waiting-woman, becomes intimate with the Third Princess. …
kobun: 朱雀院五十の賀に女楽あり、源氏の君、女三の宮に琴を教ふ。その直後、紫の上病に臥し、六条御息所の死霊の物怪と見えたり。……
kobunen: For Suzaku's fiftieth celebration a concert of women's music was held, and Genji taught the Third Princess the koto; right afterward Murasaki fell ill—possessed, it seemed, by the dead spirit of Lady Rokujō—and Genji devoted himself to nursing her. …

scene.content: 柏木、女三の宮より春宮に献ぜられた唐猫を手に入れ、愛玩。
scene.contenten: Kashiwagi obtains the Chinese cat given to the Crown Prince by the Third Princess and keeps it as a pet.

scene.content: 源氏、紫の上、明石の中宮、明石の君らを伴って、秋の住吉社に参詣。従者たち、みごとな膳部を次々と源氏らの車に運ぶ。
scene.contenten: Genji visits the autumn Sumiyoshi Shrine with Murasaki, the Akashi Empress, Lady Akashi, and others; attendants carry splendid trays of food to their carriages.

scene.content: 六条院の女楽。明石の君は琵琶、紫の上和琴、明石の中宮箏、女三の宮は琴。源氏・夕霧も加わる。
scene.contenten: Women's music at Rokujo-in: Lady Akashi on the biwa, Murasaki on the wagon, the Akashi Empress on the koto, the Third Princess on the koto; Genji and Yugiri join.

scene.content: 源氏、病後の紫の上とともに盛りの蓮の花を見、歌を詠み交わす。
scene.contenten: Genji views the blooming lotuses with Murasaki after her illness and they exchange poems.

scene.content: 小侍従、人目を忍んで、柏木よりの文を、女三の宮にみせているところに源氏が戻ってくる。
scene.contenten: Koshosho, hiding from sight, is showing Kashiwagi's letter to the Third Princess when Genji returns.

scene.content: 源氏、女三の宮のもとで柏木よりの恋文を発見。小侍従慌てる。
scene.contenten: Genji discovers Kashiwagi's love letter at the Third Princess's; Koshosho panics.

summaryen: For Emperor Suzaku's fiftieth-year celebration a concert of women's music is held, and Genji teaches Onna San no Miya the koto. Just after the concert, Murasaki no Ue falls ill, and the spirit of the dead Rokujo lady has possessed her as a vengeful ghost; Genji spares no care in nursing her. In the interval Kashiwagi, guided by the nurse Kojiju, sister of Onna San no Miya's wet nurse, realizes his long-held desire, and after further secret meetings makes her pregnant. Genji, learning the truth from a letter Kashiwagi sent her, is tormented. Meanwhile, at Genji's oblique reproof, Kashiwagi falls ill from terror and sinks into a critical state.

title: 柏木
summary: 年明けて、女三の宮は男の子・薫を生むが、柏木は病篤くして亡くなり、女三の宮も罪の意識深く、また産後の肥立ちの悪さから出家する（実際の原因としては、既に亡くなった六条御息所の物怪が女三の宮に取り憑いて出家を促させたことが背景である）。源氏は薫出生の秘密を守り通すことを決意する。一方で柏木に後事を託された親友・夕霧は、残された柏木の妻女・二宮（落葉の宮）を見舞ううちに彼女に惹かれてゆく。
gendaibun: 女三の宮のご病気のことは、世間の噂もいまいましく、内裏でもどのようにお聞きになっているのか、お気の毒にと思ってお言葉をくださるときがある。……
gendaibunen: Word of the Third Princess's illness was still more distressing in the world's gossip; even at the palace, he wondered how they had heard of it, and there were times when he offered words of sympathy, feeling for her. …
kobun: 女三の宮の御事は、まして人の聞こえもゆゆしく、内裏にも、いかにと聞こし召したるにや、いとほしう思しのたまはするをりをりあり。……
kobunen: As for the Third Princess, the talk of others was all the more ominous; even at the palace, he seemed to hear how things stood and would from time to time speak words of pity. …

scene.content: 重病の柏木、小侍従に紙燭をかかげさせ女三の宮は病床より降りて迎え、源氏もともに語り合う。
scene.contenten: The gravely ill Kashiwagi has Koshosho hold up a lamp; the Third Princess comes down from her sickbed to receive him, and Genji talks with them.

scene.content: 朱雀院、六条院に女三の宮を見舞う。女三の宮は病床より降りて迎え、源氏もともに語り合う。
scene.contenten: Emperor Suzaku visits the Third Princess at Rokujo-in; she comes down from her sickbed to receive him, and Genji talks with them as well.

scene.content: 夕霧、柏木を見舞う。柏木、後事を託す。
scene.contenten: Yugiri visits the ill Kashiwagi; Kashiwagi entrusts him with his affairs.

scene.content: 若君（薫）の五十日祝いを迎え、源氏幼児を抱いて感慨にふける。几帳を隔て尼姿の女三の宮。
scene.contenten: On the fiftieth-day celebration of the young lord (Kaoru), Genji holds the infant and muses; the Third Princess, in nun's habit, is beyond a screen.

scene.content: 夕霧、春の日に故柏木の妻、落葉の宮を一条宮に訪ね、応対に出た母御息女と語り合う、夕霧、涙を拭い鼻をかむ。
scene.contenten: On a spring day Yugiri visits the late Kashiwagi's wife, the Lady Ochiba, at Ichijo Palace, talks with her mother, and weeping, wipes his tears and blows his nose.

summaryen: With the new year, Onna San no Miya bears a boy, Kaoru, but Kashiwagi, gravely ill, dies, and Onna San no Miya, deeply conscious of her sin and slow to recover after childbirth, takes the tonsure (in truth, the ghost of the late Rokujo lady possessed her and prompted her to do so). Genji resolves to keep the secret of Kaoru's birth to the end. Meanwhile Yugiri, entrusted with Kashiwagi's last affairs by his friend, visits Kashiwagi's widow, Nio no Miya (Lady Ochiba), and is drawn to her.

title: 横笛
summary: 秋、柏木の一周忌が営まれる。落葉の宮の後見をする夕霧はその礼として宮の母から柏木遺愛の横笛を贈られるが、その夜、夢に柏木があらわれて、自分が笛を贈りたいのは別人である（薫を示唆）と言う。夕霧は源氏にこのことを相談するが、源氏は言を左右にしてはっきりと答えないまま横笛を預かる。
gendaibun: 秋、柏木の一周忌が営まれる。落葉の宮の後見をする夕霧はその礼として宮の母から柏木遺愛の横笛を贈られるが、その夜、夢に柏木があらわれて、自分が笛を贈りたいのは別人である（薫を示唆）と言う。夕霧は源氏にこのことを相談するが、源氏は言を左右にしてはっきりと答えないまま横笛を預かる。
gendaibunen: In autumn Kashiwagi's first anniversary is held. Yūgiri, guardian of the Fallen Leaves Princess, receives Kashiwagi's beloved flute from her mother; that night Kashiwagi appears in a dream and says the flute is meant for someone else—hinting at Kaoru. …
kobun: 秋、柏木の一周忌営まる。夕霧、落葉の宮の母より柏木遺愛の横笛を贈らるるに、その夜夢に柏木現れ、「この笛は別人に」と言ひたまひける。……
kobunen: In autumn the first anniversary of Kashiwagi was observed; Yūgiri, watching over the Fallen Leaves Princess, received Kashiwagi's treasured flute from her mother—and that night Kashiwagi appeared in a dream, saying the flute was meant for another. …

scene.content: 山の朱雀院より女三の宮に贈られた筍に添えられた文を源氏読む。
scene.contenten: Genji reads the letter attached to the bamboo shoots sent from the mountain Suzaku-in to the Third Princess.

scene.content: 幼い薫、這い出してきて、筍をとり口にいれたり投げ出したりするのを、源氏見て笑いたしなめる。
