scene.contenten: Young Kaoru crawls out and puts the bamboo shoots in his mouth or tosses them about; Genji watches, laughing and admonishing him.

scene.content: 源氏、薫を膝に抱きとり、話しかけ、戯れに歌を詠む。
scene.contenten: Genji holds Kaoru on his knee, speaks to him, and playfully composes a poem.

scene.content: 秋、夕霧、落葉の宮を訪問、 想夫恋を合奏。帰りに一条御息所より柏木遺愛の笛を贈られ、試みに吹き鳴らす。
scene.contenten: In autumn Yugiri visits the Lady Ochiba and they play the piece So-shi-koi together; on leaving he is given Kashiwagi's beloved flute by the Ichijo Lady Mother and tries blowing it.

scene.content: 夜更けて帰邸した夕霧の夢に柏木現われ、笛は別人に贈るつもりであったという。
scene.contenten: In a dream of Yugiri, who has returned late at night, Kashiwagi appears and says the flute was meant for another.

scene.content: 雲居雁、夜中におびえて泣く幼児を抱く。 夕霧も起きて来る。
scene.contenten: Kumoi no Kari holds a crying infant frightened in the night; Yugiri also rises.

summaryen: In autumn, the first anniversary of Kashiwagi's death is observed. Yugiri, as guardian to Lady Ochiba, is given Kashiwagi's beloved transverse flute in thanks by the lady's mother, but that night Kashiwagi appears in a dream and says that the one to whom he wishes to give the flute is another, hinting at Kaoru. Yugiri consults Genji about this, but Genji, evading the question, keeps the flute in his keeping without a clear answer.

title: 鈴虫
summary: 夏、出家した女三宮の持仏・開眼供養が行われる。秋、その御殿の庭に鈴虫を放って、源氏らが宴を行う。その夜、秋好中宮が死霊となって苦しむ母・六条御息所の慰霊のため出家したいと源氏に打ち明けるが、源氏はこれを諌める。
gendaibun: 夏、出家した女三宮の持仏・開眼供養が行われる。秋、その御殿の庭に鈴虫を放って、源氏らが宴を行う。その夜、秋好中宮が死霊となって苦しむ母・六条御息所の慰霊のため出家したいと源氏に打ち明けるが、源氏はこれを諌める。
gendaibunen: In summer a ceremony is held for the Third Princess's Buddhist image after she takes the tonsure. In autumn bell-crickets are released in her garden for a banquet. That night Akikonomu tells Genji she wishes to take orders to quiet her mother Rokujō's spirit—but Genji refuses. …
kobun: 夏、出家したる女三の宮の持仏開眼の供養あり。秋、庭に鈴虫を放ちて宴あり。秋好中宮、母の慰霊のため出家したしと打ち明く。……
kobunen: In summer the consecration of the Third Princess's personal Buddha image was held after her tonsure; in autumn bell-crickets were released in her garden and Genji and others made a banquet. …

scene.content: 蓮の花の盛りに女三の宮持仏供養。訪れてきた源氏、扇の蓮の花にかけた歌を書く。
scene.contenten: While the lotuses are in full bloom, the Third Princess makes an offering to her private Buddha; Genji, visiting, writes a poem on a lotus flower on a fan.

scene.content: 十五夜の宵、若い尼たち、仏に花を供え、端近くいる女三の宮、鈴虫の声に耳を傾ける。
scene.contenten: On the night of the full moon the young nuns offer flowers to the Buddha; the Third Princess, near the edge, listens to the bell crickets.

scene.content: 女三の宮を訪れた源氏、琴を弾く。 奥では若い尼たち、仏壇供養。そこへ殿上人たちも集まってきて、鈴虫の宴となる。
scene.contenten: Genji, visiting the Third Princess, plays the koto; within, the young nuns make offerings at the altar; courtiers gather and it becomes a bell-cricket banquet.

scene.content: そこへ殿上人たちも集まってきて、鈴虫の宴となる。
scene.contenten: Courtiers also gather there, and it becomes a bell-cricket banquet.

scene.content: 同夜、源氏や集まっていた公達ら、冷泉院の月見の宴に招かれる。源氏と冷泉院、月光の下で語り合う。
scene.contenten: The same night, Genji and the noblemen gathered are invited to Emperor Reizei's moon-viewing banquet; Genji and Reizei talk under the moonlight.

summaryen: In summer, an eye-opening ceremony is held for the Buddhist image of the tonsured Onna San no Miya. In autumn, bell crickets are released in the garden of her hall, and Genji and the others hold a banquet. That night Akikonomu tells Genji she wishes to take the tonsure to console her mother, the Rokujo lady, who suffers as a vengeful spirit, but Genji dissuades her.

title: 夕霧
summary: 秋、思いを抑えきれない夕霧は人目を忍んで落葉の宮に意中を明かすが、彼女はこれを受け入れない。しかし世上による両人の噂は高く、落葉の宮の母御息所はこれを苦にして病死する。落葉の宮はいっそう夕霧を厭うが、夕霧は強引に彼女との契りを結び、妻とする。雲居雁は嫉妬のあまり父・致仕太政大臣（かつての頭中将）のもとへ帰って、夕霧の弁明をも聞きつけない。末尾に夕霧の行末とその一門の繁栄が語られる。
gendaibun: 秋、思いを抑えきれない夕霧は人目を忍んで落葉の宮に意中を明かすが、彼女はこれを受け入れない。しかし世上による両人の噂は高く、落葉の宮の母御息所はこれを苦にして病死する。落葉の宮はいっそう夕霧を厭うが、夕霧は強引に彼女との契りを結び、妻とする。……
gendaibunen: In autumn Yūgiri can no longer hold back and secretly confesses to the Fallen Leaves Princess; she refuses, but rumor spreads and her mother dies of worry. The princess shuns him still more, yet Yūgiri's passion only deepens. …
kobun: 秋、夕霧、人目を忍びて落葉の宮に意を明かすも、受けられず。世上の噂高く、母御息所はこれを苦にして病死したまふ。……
kobunen: In autumn Yūgiri, no longer able to restrain himself, slipped unseen to the Fallen Leaves Princess and declared his love; she would not accept him, yet worldly rumor rose high, and her mother the consort fell ill and died of the distress. …

scene.content: 小野の山荘を訪れ、以前からの思慕の情を落葉の宮に打ち明けた夕霧、宮の居室に入り、逃れようとする宮の御衣の裾を捉える。
scene.contenten: Yugiri, visiting the Ono villa, confesses his long-held love to the Lady Ochiba, enters her room, and catches the hem of her robe as she tries to flee.

scene.content: 自邸で、一条御息所の文を読む夕霧に雲居雁忍びより手紙を奪う。
scene.contenten: At his own residence, as Yugiri reads the Ichijo Lady Mother's letter, Kumoi no Kari steals up and snatches it.

scene.content: 翌朝、雲居雁の隠した文を探す夕霧。 室内で子供たち騒ぐ。
scene.contenten: The next morning Yugiri searches for the letter Kumoi no Kari hid; the children make a racket in the room.

scene.content: 小野の山荘の妻戸のわきに立つ夕霧、秋の夕陽に扇をかざす。垣の外には鹿が鳴いている。
scene.contenten: Standing by the door of the Ono villa, Yugiri holds a fan up to the autumn sunset; a deer cries beyond the fence.

scene.content: 致仕の大臣の文を持ち、蔵人少将(柏木の弟)、 落葉の宮を訪れる。
scene.contenten: Bearing a letter from the retired Minister, Kurando no Shosho (Kashiwagi's younger brother) visits the Lady Ochiba.

summaryen: In autumn, Yugiri, unable to restrain his feelings, secretly reveals his love to Lady Ochiba, but she does not accept it. Yet the talk about the two runs high, and Lady Ochiba's mother, the lady, grieves over it and dies of illness. Lady Ochiba detests Yugiri all the more, but Yugiri forces a union with her and makes her his wife. Kumoi no Kari, in a fit of jealousy, returns to her father the retired Grand Minister, formerly the Head Chamberlain, and will not even hear Yugiri's explanation. At the end, Yugiri's future and the prosperity of his house are told.

title: 御法
summary: 「若菜」の大病から紫の上の健康は優れず、たびたび出家を願うが源氏はこれを許さず、紫の上はせめて仏事によって後世を願う。春から秋に掛けての、六条院最後の栄華と紫の上の病状が描かれる。秋、紫の上は病死し、源氏は深い悲嘆にくれる。
gendaibun: 「若菜」の大病から紫の上の健康は優れず、たびたび出家を願うが源氏はこれを許さず、紫の上はせめて仏事によって後世を願う。春から秋に掛けての、六条院最後の栄華と紫の上の病状が描かれる。秋、紫の上は病死し、源氏は深い悲嘆にくれる。
gendaibunen: After her long illness, Murasaki never fully recovers. She repeatedly asks to take Buddhist vows; Genji refuses. From spring to autumn the last glory of Rokujō-in unfolds beside her decline; in autumn she dies, and Genji's grief is beyond measure. …
kobun: 紫の上、健康すぐれず、たびたび出家を願へども源氏許さず。春から秋にかけ、六条院最後の栄華と病状描かる。秋、紫の上病死したまふ。……
kobunen: After the great illness of the Wakana years, Murasaki's strength never fully returned; again and again she asked to take orders, yet Genji would not permit it, and she sought at least to secure the next life through Buddhist rites. …

scene.content: 三月、紫の上の中宮、匂宮らを連れて紫の上を見舞う。紫の上、匂宮に庭前の紅梅と桜をこの後も慈しんでいくれるよう頼む。
scene.contenten: In the third month the Empress Murasaki visits Murasaki with Prince Niou and others; Murasaki asks Prince Niou to cherish the red plums and cherries in the garden hereafter.

scene.content: 夏、明石の中宮、匂宮らを連れて紫の上を見舞う。紫の上、匂宮に庭前の紅梅と桜をこの後も慈しんでくれるように頼む。
scene.contenten: In summer the Akashi Empress visits Murasaki with Prince Niou and others; Murasaki asks Prince Niou to cherish the garden's red plums and cherries hereafter.

scene.content: 秋の夕暮れ、重病の紫の上、風に吹かれる前栽を見て、源氏・明石の中宮と歌を交わす。
scene.contenten: On an autumn evening the gravely ill Murasaki, seeing the garden plants blown by the wind, exchanges poems with Genji and the Akashi Empress.

summaryen: Murasaki no Ue's health has been poor since her grave illness in Wakana, and she repeatedly wishes to take the tonsure, but Genji does not permit it, and she at least seeks salvation in Buddhist rites. The last glory of the Rokujo-in, from spring to autumn, and Murasaki no Ue's illness are depicted. In autumn Murasaki no Ue dies of illness, and Genji is plunged into deep grief.

title: 幻
summary: 紫の上亡き後の源氏の一年を四季の風物を主として叙情的に描く。年末に源氏は出家の意志をかため、女君たちとの手紙を焼き捨てる。
gendaibun: 紫の上亡き後の源氏の一年を四季の風物を主として叙情的に描く。年末に源氏は出家の意志をかため、女君たちとの手紙を焼き捨てる。
gendaibunen: After Murasaki's death, Genji's mourning is told through the year's seasons. At year's end he resolves to take Buddhist orders and burns the women's letters. …
kobun: 紫の上亡き後の源氏の君の悲しみを、四季の風物に寄せて描く。年末、出家の志を固め、女君たちの文を焼き捨てたまふ。……
kobunen: After Murasaki's death, Genji's sorrow was told through the seasons; at year's end he resolved to leave the world and burned the letters of the women he had loved. …

scene.content: 紫の上を失った翌春、悲しみにくれる源氏は御簾の内に籠もり、参賀の人々にも会わず、 螢兵部卿宮とのみ歌を交わす。宮、紅梅の下に歩み出る。
scene.contenten: The spring after losing Murasaki, grieving Genji stays behind the blinds, sees no New Year visitors, and exchanges poems only with Hotaru Hyobukyo no Miya, who steps out beneath the red plums.

scene.content: 晩春、二条院の桜の盛りに紫の上を想い嘆く源氏。紫の上遺愛の桜を散らすまいとする匂宮の無邪気さに慰められる。
scene.contenten: In late spring Genji longs and grieves for Murasaki amid the blooming cherries of Nijo-in; he is comforted by Prince Niou's innocence in not letting Murasaki's beloved cherries scatter.

scene.content: 源氏、六条院の女三の宮を訪ねる。匂宮も侍女に抱かれて来、幼い薫と遊ぶ。 女三の宮、仏前で読経する。
scene.contenten: Genji visits the Third Princess at Rokujo-in; Prince Niou also comes in a lady's arms and plays with young Kaoru; the Third Princess chants sutras before the Buddha.

scene.content: 源氏、紫の上の残した文を読んで泣き、歌を書きつけてから皆焼いてしまう。
scene.contenten: Genji reads the writings Murasaki left, weeps, writes a poem, and then burns them all.

scene.content: 御仏名の導師の僧を、源氏ねぎらう。咲き始めた梅の花に雪。
scene.contenten: Genji thanks the officiating monk of the Buddha-name service; snow falls on the plum blossoms just beginning to open.

summaryen: Genji's year after Murasaki no Ue's death is depicted lyrically, chiefly through the scenery of the four seasons. At year's end Genji resolves to take the tonsure and burns the letters of his ladies.

title: 匂宮
summary: 物語は源氏の死の数年後から始まる。源氏一門の繁栄は明石中宮と朱雀帝の子・今上帝の皇子たちを中心にゆるぎない。ことに明石中宮腹の三宮は色好みで名高く、薫と並んで世にもてはやされている。天然の薫香が身から発するために「薫」、それに対抗して名香を常に焚きしめているために「匂宮」と二人は呼ばれる。
gendaibun: 物語は源氏の死の数年後から始まる。源氏一門の繁栄は明石中宮と朱雀帝の子・今上帝の皇子たちを中心にゆるぎない。ことに明石中宮腹の三宮は色好みで名高く、薫と並んで世にもてはやされている。天然の薫香が身から発するために「薫」、それに対抗して名香を常に焚きしめているために「匂宮」と二人は呼ばれる。
gendaibunen: Years after Genji's death, his house still flourishes around the Akashi Empress and the emperor's sons. The Third Prince (Niou), noted for amorous charm, is paired in fame with Kaoru, from whose person a natural fragrance rises. …
kobun: 源氏の君亡き数年の後。明石中宮と今上帝の皇子たちを中心に一門栄ゆ。匂宮と薫、世にもてはやされける。……
kobunen: The tale resumes some years after Genji's death. The prosperity of his line stands firm around the Akashi Empress and the sons of the present emperor; among them the Third Prince, famed for love affairs, is celebrated alongside Kaoru—from whose body a natural fragrance rises. …

scene.content: 正月十八日、弓場殿で賭弓。
scene.contenten: On the eighteenth day of the first month, an archery contest at the Yuba-den.

scene.content: 夕霧の催す賭弓の還饗に、匂宮・薫ら車を連ね、六条院へ。雪降る。
scene.contenten: At the banquet of the archery contest hosted by Yugiri, Prince Niou, Kaoru, and others line up their carriages and go to Rokujo-in; snow falls.

scene.content: 梅薫る下で六条院の還饗。女房ら物陰より覗き見る。
scene.contenten: A banquet at Rokujo-in beneath fragrant plums; ladies peek from the shadows.

summaryen: The story begins several years after Genji's death. The prosperity of Genji's house is unshaken, centered on Lady Akashi's daughter and the princes of the present Emperor, son of Emperor Suzaku. In particular the Third Prince born of Akashi's daughter is famed as a lover, and is feted along with Kaoru. Because a natural fragrance issues from his body he is called Kaoru, and because in rivalry he constantly burns fine incense the two are called Niou Miya, the Fragrant Prince.

title: 紅梅
summary: 柏木没後の頭中将家の物語。致仕太政大臣（頭中将）の孫娘・中の君と匂宮との結婚が画策されるが、真木柱の姫君と蛍兵部卿宮の娘に心惹かれる匂宮は相手にしない。後人の偽作説が濃厚。
gendaibun: 柏木没後の頭中将家の物語。致仕太政大臣（頭中将）の孫娘・中の君と匂宮との結婚が画策されるが、真木柱の姫君と蛍兵部卿宮の娘に心惹かれる匂宮は相手にしない。後人の偽作説が濃厚。
gendaibunen: After Kashiwagi's death, the story turns to Tō no Chūjō's family. A match is planned between his granddaughter and Niou, but Niou prefers other women and ignores it. (Often judged a later interpolation.) …
kobun: 柏木没後の頭中将家の物語。中の君と匂宮の縁組画策さるれど、匂宮は他の姫君に心ありて相手にせず。……
kobunen: This is the tale of Tō no Chūjō's house after Kashiwagi's death: a marriage is plotted between his granddaughter Naka no Kimi and Prince Niou, yet Niou, drawn to other ladies, will not take the bait. …

scene.content: 按察大納言、参内しようとする直衣姿の若君に笛の稽古をさせる。奥にいる宮の姫君にも琵琶を合わせるよう勧める。
scene.contenten: The Azechi Dainagon has the young lord in noshi, about to go to court, practice the flute; he urges the princess of the household within to join on the biwa.

scene.content: 大納言、紅梅の枝に文をつけ、宮中の匂宮に届けるようにと若君に言いつける。
scene.contenten: The Dainagon attaches a letter to a red plum branch and orders the young lord to deliver it to Prince Niou in the palace.

scene.content: 若君、明石の中宮のもとにいる匂宮に、文と紅梅の枝を渡す。
scene.contenten: The young lord gives the letter and red plum branch to Prince Niou at the Akashi Empress's.

summaryen: The story of the Head Chamberlain's house after Kashiwagi's death. A marriage is plotted between the retired Grand Minister's granddaughter, Naka no Kimi, and Niou Miya, but Niou, drawn to the daughter of Makibashira and the Hotaru Hyobukyo Prince, pays her no heed. It is widely held to be a later hand's forgery.

title: 竹河
summary: 鬚黒没後の一家の物語。玉鬘の二人の娘は、大君が冷泉院に嫁し、中の君が宮中に出仕することになる。夕霧はこの一家と親しく、彼女たちから好感を持たれている。後人の偽作説が濃厚。
gendaibun: 鬚黒没後の一家の物語。玉鬘の二人の娘は、大君が冷泉院に嫁し、中の君が宮中に出仕することになる。夕霧はこの一家と親しく、彼女たちから好感を持たれている。後人の偽作説が濃厚。
gendaibunen: After Higekuro's death, Tamakazura's two daughters find their paths: one marries Reizei, the other enters court service. Yūgiri grows close to the household and is well liked. (Often judged a later interpolation.) …
kobun: 髭黒没後の一家。玉鬘の娘、大君は冷泉院に、中の君は宮中に出仕す。夕霧、この一家と親しく交はりたまふ。……
kobunen: This is the tale of Higekuro's house after his death: Tamakazura's two daughters—the elder married to Retired Emperor Reizei, the younger entering palace service—grow close to Yūgiri, who is warmly received by the family. …

scene.content: 薫、早春の玉鬘邸で梅に鳴く鶯を聞き、女房たちと歌を詠み交わす。
scene.contenten: Kaoru, at Tamakazura's residence in early spring, hears a warbler singing on the plum and exchanges poems with the ladies.

scene.content: 梅の盛りの玉邸で薫、 蔵人少将に会う。 奥では女房たち、琵琶や箏を弾く。
scene.contenten: At Tamakazura's residence in plum season, Kaoru meets Kurando no Shosho; within, the ladies play the biwa and koto.

scene.content: 玉鬘の姫君たち、庭の桜を賭けて碁を打つ。勝ち方の童女、庭におりて花を拾う。蔵人少将このようすを覗き見る。
scene.contenten: Tamakazura's daughters play go wagering on the garden cherries; the winning girl goes into the garden to pick flowers; Kurando no Shosho peeks at this.

scene.content: 晩春の夕、冷泉院の庭で松にかかる藤を、薫、藤侍従とともに眺める。
scene.contenten: On a late-spring evening, in Emperor Reizei's garden, Kaoru and Fuji no Chujo gaze at wisteria on a pine.

summaryen: The story of the family after Higekuro's death. Of Tamakazura's two daughters, the elder marries Emperor Reizei and the younger enters court service. Yugiri is close to this family and is well regarded by them. It is widely held to be a later hand's forgery.

title: 橋姫
summary: 源氏の弟・八の宮は二人の娘とともに宇治に隠棲し、仏道三昧の生活を送る。みずからの出生に悩む薫は八の宮の生き方を理想としてしばしば邸を訪れるうちに、ふとしたことから長女・大君に深く心を引かれるようになる。都に戻って薫が宇治の有様を語ると、匂宮もこれに興味をそそられる。
gendaibun: そのころ、世間であまり顧みられなかった古い宮がいらした。母宮に先立たれ、中将の君と呼ばれる御子たちを連れて、宇治の山庄に引きこもっていられた。……
gendaibunen: In those days there was an old prince whom the world little regarded. After his mother the princess died, he took the young men called the Middle Captain's sons and shut himself away in a mountain villa at Uji. …
kobun: そのころ、世にかずまへられたまはぬ古宮おはしけり。母宮に後れたまひて、中将の君と聞ゆる御子たちを率て、宇治の山庄にこもりゐたまへり。……
kobunen: In those days there was an aged prince whom the world scarcely counted among its number. Having lost his mother the princess, he withdrew with the young men known as the Middle Captain's sons to a mountain villa at Uji. …

scene.content: 九月、薫、霧深く木の茂る山路を馬で宇治八の宮のもとに向かう。
scene.contenten: In the ninth month Kaoru rides along a misty, tree-grown mountain road toward the Eighth Prince at Uji.

scene.content: 宇治の中の君、さしでた月を揆で招き、大君、琴をひきさして笑う。薫、有明の月に照らされた姉妹を垣間見る。
scene.contenten: The middle sister at Uji invites the rising moon with a cup, and the eldest plays the koto and laughs; Kaoru glimpses the sisters lit by the moon at dawn.

scene.content: 改めて案内を乞うた薫、姫君たちのいる御簾の前に座り、物語をする。弁の御許、姫君の代わりに応対。
scene.contenten: Kaoru, asking to be guided again, sits before the blinds where the princesses are and talks; Ben no Okina answers for the princesses.

scene.content: 十月、八の宮、薫を迎えて琴を弾き、薫は琵琶を合わす。
scene.contenten: In the tenth month the Eighth Prince receives Kaoru and plays the koto; Kaoru joins on the biwa.

scene.content: 八の宮、 暁の勤行に立ったあと、薫、弁の御許より柏木と女三の宮の秘密を聞き、文反故を受け取る。
scene.contenten: After the Eighth Prince rises at dawn for devotions, Kaoru hears from Ben no Okina of the secret between Kashiwagi and the Third Princess and receives paper scraps.

summaryen: The Eighth Prince, Genji's younger brother, retires to Uji with his two daughters and leads a life devoted to Buddhism. Kaoru, troubled over his own birth, takes the Eighth Prince's way of life as his ideal and often visits his residence, and by chance comes to be deeply drawn to the elder daughter, Oigimi. When Kaoru returns to the capital and tells Niou of Uji, Niou too becomes interested.

title: 椎本
summary: 春、匂宮は宇治に立寄り、次女・中君と歌の贈答をする。秋、八の宮が薨去。二人の姫君たちは薫に托された。薫は中君と匂宮の結婚を計画し、自らはを大君に思いを告げるが彼女の返答はつれない。しかし薫の慕情はいっそうつのる。
gendaibun: 春、匂宮は宇治に立寄り、次女・中君と歌の贈答をする。秋、八の宮が薨去。二人の姫君たちは薫に托された。薫は中君と匂宮の結婚を計画し、自らはを大君に思いを告げるが彼女の返答はつれない。しかし薫の慕情はいっそうつのる。
gendaibunen: In spring Niou visits Uji and exchanges poems with the younger sister. In autumn the Eighth Prince dies; the two sisters are entrusted to Kaoru. He plans to marry Naka no Kimi to Niou and confesses his love to the elder sister, who answers coldly—yet his longing only grows. …
kobun: 春、匂宮宇治に立ち寄り、中君と歌の贈答あり。秋、八の宮薨去し、二人の姫君、薫に託さる。薫、大君に思いを告ぐれど、返事つれなし。……
kobunen: In spring Prince Niou stopped at Uji and exchanged poems with the younger sister Naka no Kimi; in autumn the Eighth Prince died, and the two princesses were entrusted to Kaoru. …

scene.content: 春、夕霧の宇治山荘で薫、匂宮ら宴遊。対岸の八の宮より薫に文届く。
scene.contenten: In spring at Yugiri's Uji villa, Kaoru and Prince Niou feast and amuse themselves; a letter from the Eighth Prince on the opposite shore reaches Kaoru.

scene.content: 招かれた公達ら船で八の宮の山荘に向かう。 船中で管弦。
scene.contenten: The invited noblemen go by boat to the Eighth Prince's villa, making music aboard.

scene.content: 月の明るい秋の夜、訪ねてきた薫に、自らの死を予感した八の宮、姫君たちのことを託す。
scene.contenten: On a moonlit autumn night the Eighth Prince, sensing his own death, entrusts his daughters to the visiting Kaoru.

scene.content: 歳の暮れ近く、宇治の姫君たちのもとに山の阿闍梨より炭などが届けられる。 姫君たちは綿、絹を贈る。
scene.contenten: Near year's end, charcoal and such arrive from the mountain acarya for the Uji princesses; they give cotton and silk in return.

scene.content: 薫、故八の宮の仏間に入り宮の生前を回想して柱にもたれ歌を詠む。女房ら、その姿を覗き見る。
scene.contenten: Kaoru enters the late Eighth Prince's Buddha room, recalls the prince's life, leans on a pillar and composes a poem; the ladies peek at him.

summaryen: In spring, Niou stops at Uji and exchanges poems with the younger daughter, Naka no Kimi. In autumn, the Eighth Prince passes away. The two princesses are entrusted to Kaoru. Kaoru plans a marriage between Naka no Kimi and Niou, and himself declares his love to Oigimi, but her answer is cold. Yet Kaoru's longing only grows.

title: 総角
summary: 薫は再び大君に語らうが思いは受け入れられず、むしろ大君は中君と薫の結婚を望む。秋の終わり、大君により中君と薫が一つ閨に取り残されるが、薫は彼女に手を触れようとしない。やがて当初の計画通りに薫は匂宮と中君の結婚を果たすが、匂宮の訪れは途絶えがちで、これを恨んだ大君は病に臥し、ついには薫の腕のなかではかなくなる。
gendaibun: 薫は再び大君に語らうが思いは受け入れられず、むしろ大君は中君と薫の結婚を望む。秋の終わり、大君により中君と薫が一つ閨に取り残されるが、薫は彼女に手を触れようとしない。やがて当初の計画通りに薫は匂宮と中君の結婚を果たすが、匂宮の訪れは途絶えがちで、これを恨んだ大君は病に臥し、ついには薫の腕のなかではかなくなる。
gendaibunen: Kaoru again courts the elder sister; she refuses and hopes he will marry the younger. Late in autumn she leaves Kaoru and Naka no Kimi alone together, but he will not touch her. As planned, Kaoru later brings Niou and Naka no Kimi together; the elder sister dies of illness. …
kobun: 薫、再び大君に語らへども受けられず。秋の終わり、中君と薫一つ閨に残さるるも、薫は手触れず。やがて大君、病にて亡くなりたまふ。……
kobunen: Again Kaoru spoke his love to the elder sister; she would not accept him, and rather wished him married to her younger sister. Late in autumn she left Kaoru and Naka no Kimi alone in one chamber—yet he would not touch her. …

scene.content: 宇治の秋の夜、薫、屏風を押し開け、執拗に大君に迫るが、つれなく拒まれる。
scene.contenten: On an autumn night at Uji, Kaoru pushes open a screen and persistently presses the eldest sister, but is coldly refused.

scene.content: 匂宮、薫とともに勾欄により遣水に月の映る秋の庭を眺め、宇治の姫君たちへの想いを語り合う。
scene.contenten: Prince Niou and Kaoru, leaning on the balustrade, view the autumn garden with the moon reflected in the stream and speak of their feelings for the Uji princesses.

scene.content: 匂宮、中の君と明けゆく宇治川を眺める。霧立ち、柴を積んだ舟が川面を行き交う。
scene.contenten: Prince Niou and the middle sister watch the Uji River at dawn; mist rises and boats piled with brushwood pass on the water.

scene.content: 十月、匂宮と薫ら、宇治川に舟を浮かべて紅葉狩り。 八の宮の山荘より女たちそのさまを眺める
scene.contenten: In the tenth month Prince Niou, Kaoru, and others float boats on the Uji River for autumn-leaf viewing; women watch from the Eighth Prince's villa.

summaryen: Kaoru speaks with Oigimi again, but his love is not accepted; rather, Oigimi wishes Naka no Kimi to marry Kaoru. At the end of autumn, Oigimi leaves Naka no Kimi and Kaoru alone together, but Kaoru does not lay a hand on her. Eventually Kaoru brings about the marriage of Niou and Naka no Kimi as first planned, but Niou's visits grow infrequent, and Oigimi, resenting this, falls ill and at last dies in Kaoru's arms.

title: 早蕨
summary: 翌年、大君の喪が明けて中君は匂宮の元に引き取られる。薫は後見として彼女のために尽くすが、それがかえって匂宮に疑われる。
gendaibun: 翌年、大君の喪が明けて中君は匂宮の元に引き取られる。薫は後見として彼女のために尽くすが、それがかえって匂宮に疑われる。
gendaibunen: The next year, after mourning ends, Naka no Kimi is taken into Niou's household. Kaoru helps as her guardian—yet that very devotion makes Niou jealous. …
kobun: 翌年、大君の喪明けて、中君は匂宮のもとに引き取らる。薫、後見として尽くすが、かえって匂宮に疑はる。……
kobunen: The next year, when mourning for the elder sister ended, Naka no Kimi was taken into Niou's household; Kaoru served as her guardian, yet that very care made Niou suspicious. …

scene.content: 大君亡きあと、寂しく暮らす中の君のもとに、山の阿闍梨より籠にいれた蕨や土筆が文を添えて贈られる。
scene.contenten: After the eldest sister's death, the mountain acarya sends the lonely middle sister a basket of bracken and horsetails with a letter.

scene.content: 庭前の紅梅を愛でながら箏を掻き鳴らす匂宮のもとを訪れた薫、紅梅の枝を折り、匂宮に歌を詠みかける。
scene.contenten: Visiting Prince Niou, who plucks the koto before the garden's red plums, Kaoru breaks off a red plum branch and recites a poem to him.

scene.content: 京の匂宮のもとへ移る中の君、大君を偲んで悲しむところへ、薫来訪。前に姫君たちをかいまみた障子の穴に寄って見るが、室内は見えない。
scene.contenten: The middle sister, moving to Prince Niou's in the capital, grieves for the eldest; Kaoru visits and looks through the hole in the sliding door where he once glimpsed the princesses, but cannot see inside.

scene.content: 中の君、上洛を前に弁の尼との別れを悲しむ。
scene.contenten: The middle sister grieves over parting with the nun Ben before going up to the capital.

summaryen: The following year, when mourning for Oigimi ends, Naka no Kimi is taken in by Niou. Kaoru devotes himself to her as her guardian, but this rather makes Niou suspicious.

title: 宿木
summary: 匂宮と夕霧の娘・六の君が結婚し、懐妊中の中君は行末を不安に思う。それを慰めるうちに彼女に恋情を抱き始めた薫に中君は当惑するが、無事男子を出産して安定した地位を得る。一方で薫は今上帝の皇女・女二宮と結婚するが傷心は癒されない。しかし初瀬詣の折に、故大君に生き写しである中君の異母妹・浮舟を垣間見て、心を動かされる。
gendaibun: 匂宮と夕霧の娘・六の君が結婚し、懐妊中の中君は行末を不安に思う。それを慰めるうちに彼女に恋情を抱き始めた薫に中君は当惑するが、無事男子を出産して安定した地位を得る。一方で薫は今上帝の皇女・女二宮と結婚するが傷心は癒されない。しかし初瀬詣の折に、故大君に生き写しである中君の異母妹・浮舟を垣間見て、心を動かされる。
gendaibunen: Niou marries Yūgiri's sixth daughter; pregnant Naka no Kimi fears for her future. While comforting her, Kaoru falls in love, to her dismay—until she bears a son and her standing stabilizes. Kaoru meanwhile marries the emperor's Second Princess, yet his heart remains unsettled. …
kobun: 匂宮、夕霧の六の君と結婚し、懐妊中の中君は行末を憂ふ。薫、これを慰むるうち恋情を抱き、中君当惑す。男子出産の後、薫は女二宮と結婚す。……
kobunen: Niou married Yūgiri's Sixth Daughter; Naka no Kimi, already with child, feared for her future. Comforting her, Kaoru began to feel desire, which distressed her—until she safely bore a son and her position grew secure. …

scene.content: 女二の宮を薫に降嫁させようと考える帝、薫を碁の相手に召し寄せる。清涼殿東庭の白菊が霜のため色が変わっている頃である。
scene.contenten: The Emperor, thinking to marry the Second Princess to Kaoru, summons Kaoru as a go partner; it is the time when white chrysanthemums in the east garden of the Seiryoden have changed color from frost.

scene.content: 帝、薫に碁の賭物として菊を折らせ、女二の宮降嫁の意を仄めかす。
scene.contenten: The Emperor has Kaoru pluck a chrysanthemum as a go wager and hints at the Second Princess's marriage.

scene.content: 夕霧の六の君との結婚のため、六条院へ出かける匂宮を見送り、中の君憂悶する。
scene.contenten: Seeing off Prince Niou, who sets out for Rokujo-in to marry Yugiri's Sixth Daughter, the middle sister frets.

scene.content: 宇治を訪れた薫より土産として中の君のもとに届けられた山蔦と文を見た匂宮、嫉妬しながらも、わざと返事を書くように勧める。
scene.contenten: Prince Niou, seeing the mountain ivy and letter sent as a gift to the middle sister by Kaoru, who visited Uji, jealously yet deliberately urges her to reply.

scene.content: 匂宮、晩秋の庭を肌に琵琶を弾き、中の君は脇息によって思い悩む。
scene.contenten: Prince Niou plays the biwa in the late-autumn garden, and the middle sister leans on an armrest in distress.

summaryen: Niou marries Roku no Kimi, the daughter of Yugiri, and Naka no Kimi, pregnant, feels anxious about her future. Kaoru begins to feel love for her while consoling her, and Naka no Kimi is perplexed, but she safely bears a boy and gains a settled position. Meanwhile Kaoru marries Onna Ni no Miya, a princess of the present Emperor, but his sorrow is not healed. On a pilgrimage to Hatsuse, however, he glimpses Ukifune, Naka no Kimi's half-sister, who is the very image of the late Oigimi, and is stirred.

title: 東屋
summary: 浮舟は母の再婚により田舎受領・常陸介の継娘として育てられ、父の財力のために求婚者は多い。しかし母は高貴の男性との婚姻を望んで、彼女を中君のもとに預ける。母の意中は薫にあったが、ある夜、匂宮が見つけて強引に契りを結ぼうとしたためにあわてて浮舟を引き取り、後に薫と相談して宇治に移す。
gendaibun: 浮舟は母の再婚により田舎受領・常陸介の継娘として育てられ、父の財力のために求婚者は多い。しかし母は高貴の男性との婚姻を望んで、彼女を中君のもとに預ける。母の意中は薫にあったが、ある夜、匂宮が見つけて強引に契りを結ぼうとしたためにあわてて浮舟を引き取り、後に薫と相談して宇治に移す。
gendaibunen: Ukifune is raised as a provincial official's stepdaughter; suitors come for her father's wealth, but her mother wants a noble marriage and places her with Naka no Kimi. Her mother hopes for Kaoru—yet one night Niou finds Ukifune and forces himself upon her. …
kobun: 浮舟、母の再婚により常陸介の継娘として育つ。母、高貴の縁を望み、中君のもとに預く。ある夜、匂宮見つけ、強引に逢ひたまふ。……
kobunen: Ukifune, raised as stepdaughter of a provincial governor after her mother's remarriage, had many suitors for her father's wealth; yet her mother wished a noble match and placed her in Naka no Kimi's care. …

scene.content: 匂宮、障子を開けて浮舟の裾を捉える。 浮舟、扇をかざしながら宮を振り向き見る。
scene.contenten: Prince Niou opens the sliding door and catches Ukifune's hem; Ukifune turns to look at him, holding up her fan.

scene.content: 中の君、絵を出して浮舟に見せ、右近に物語の詞を読ませる。
scene.contenten: The middle sister brings out pictures to show Ukifune and has Ukon read the text of the tale.

scene.content: 薫、三条の浮舟の隠れ家を訪ね、雨の簀子に待つ。
scene.contenten: Kaoru visits Ukifune's hideaway at Sanjo and waits on the rainy veranda.

scene.content: 三条の隠れ家で一夜を明かした薫、車を妻戸に寄せて浮舟を乗せ宇治に移そうとする。
scene.contenten: Kaoru, having spent the night at the Sanjo hideaway, brings his carriage to the door, takes Ukifune aboard, and tries to move her to Uji.

summaryen: Ukifune is raised by her mother's remarriage as the stepdaughter of a provincial governor, the Hitachi no Suke, and because of her father's wealth has many suitors. But her mother, wishing her to marry a nobleman, places her with Naka no Kimi. Her mother's hope is for Kaoru, but one night Niou discovers her and tries to force a union, so she is hurriedly taken away and later, after consultation with Kaoru, moved to Uji.

title: 浮舟
summary: 浮舟への執心やまぬ匂宮は、中君への手紙から彼女の居所を察し、薫を装って宇治に赴き、強引に浮舟との関係を結ぶ。やがて浮舟も宮を憎からず思うようになるが、何も知らない薫は彼女を京に移そうと準備を始め、匂宮もこれに対抗してみずからのもとに彼女を連れ去る計画を立てる。その結果、匂宮とのことは薫の知るところとなり、裏切りをなじる歌を贈られた浮舟は二人の男のあいだで懊悩する。
gendaibun: 浮舟への執心やまぬ匂宮は、中君への手紙から彼女の居所を察し、薫を装って宇治に赴き、強引に浮舟との関係を結ぶ。やがて浮舟も宮を憎からず思うようになるが、何も知らない薫は彼女を京に移そうと準備を始め、匂宮もこれに対抗してみずからのもとに彼女を連れ去る計画を立てる。……
gendaibunen: Still obsessed, Niou finds Ukifune at Uji by posing as Kaoru and forces an affair. Ukifune comes to care for him, while Kaoru—unaware—prepares to bring her to the capital. Torn between them, Ukifune falls into despair. …
kobun: 匂宮、薫を装ひて宇治に赴き、浮舟と強引に関係す。浮舟もやがて宮を憎からず思ふ。知らぬ薫は、彼女を京へ移さむと支度す。……
kobunen: Niou, still obsessed with Ukifune, guessed her hiding place from a letter to Naka no Kimi, went to Uji disguised as Kaoru, and forced a relationship; in time Ukifune came not to hate him—while Kaoru, knowing nothing, prepared to move her to the capital. …

scene.content: 正月、中の君のもとで若君をあやし遊ぶ匂宮。そこへ、居所を隠している浮舟よりの文をつけた小松と髭籠を持った女童が走って来る。
scene.contenten: At New Year Prince Niou plays with the young lord at the middle sister's; a girl running with a small pine and a basket attached to a letter from Ukifune, who is hiding her whereabouts, arrives.

scene.content: 匂宮、忍んで宇治の浮舟を訪ね、隙間より室内を覗く。浮舟は縫物をする女たちの間に臥す。
scene.contenten: Prince Niou steals to visit Ukifune at Uji and peeks inside through a gap; Ukifune lies among the women sewing.

scene.content: 春の日を浮舟とともに過ごす匂宮、男女が寄り添って乱している絵を描いて浮舟に見せる。
scene.contenten: Prince Niou, spending a spring day with Ukifune, draws a picture of a man and woman lying close together and shows it to her.

scene.content: 雪の中、匂宮、浮舟を小舟に乗せて宇治川を渡り、橘の小島で愛を誓う。
scene.contenten: In the snow Prince Niou sets Ukifune in a small boat, crosses the Uji River, and pledges love on the tangerine islet.

scene.content: 夜、宇治に忍んだ匂宮、薫の命で警戒が厳しく邸に入れず、野原に侍従を呼び出して逢う。
scene.contenten: At night Prince Niou, stealing into Uji, cannot enter the residence because Kaoru has set strict guards, and calls a lady out to the field to meet.

summaryen: Niou, unable to give up his longing for Ukifune, guesses her whereabouts from a letter to Naka no Kimi, goes to Uji posing as Kaoru, and forces a union with Ukifune. In time Ukifune comes not to dislike him, but Kaoru, knowing nothing, begins preparations to move her to the capital, and Niou too plans to take her away to his own side in opposition. As a result the affair with Niou comes to Kaoru's knowledge, and Ukifune, sent a poem reproaching her betrayal, is torn between the two men.

title: 蜻蛉
summary: 浮舟は行方不明になり、後に残された女房たちは入水自殺を図ったと悟って嘆き悲しみながらも、真相を隠すために急遽葬儀を行う。薫もこのことを知って悲嘆にくれる。夏になって、薫は新たに妻の姉・女一宮に心惹かれるものを感じる。
gendaibun: 浮舟は行方不明になり、後に残された女房たちは入水自殺を図ったと悟って嘆き悲しみながらも、真相を隠すために急遽葬儀を行う。薫もこのことを知って悲嘆にくれる。夏になって、薫は新たに妻の姉・女一宮に心惹かれるものを感じる。
gendaibunen: Ukifune disappears. The women left behind think she drowned herself; they grieve yet hold a hasty funeral to conceal the truth. Kaoru, hearing of it, is devastated. In summer his heart turns toward his wife's elder sister. …
kobun: 浮舟行方不明となり、女房たち入水と悟りて嘆くも、急遽葬儀を営む。薫もこれを知りて悲嘆す。……
kobunen: Ukifune vanished; the women left behind, believing she had thrown herself into the river, mourned yet hastily held a funeral to hide the truth—and Kaoru, learning of it, was also lost in grief. …

scene.content: 薫、 前庭の橘の花が香るなかで時鳥の鳴き渡るのを聞く。
scene.contenten: Kaoru hears a cuckoo calling as the tangerine flowers in the front garden scent the air.

scene.content: 夏の夕暮れ、薄物を着た女一の宮や女房ら、氷をもって涼むようすを薫覗き見る。
scene.contenten: On a summer evening Kaoru peeks at the First Princess and the ladies in thin robes cooling themselves with ice.

scene.content: 女一の宮の美しさに立ち去りがたい思いの薫、下使いの女房が引き返して来るのに気付き、身を隠す。
scene.contenten: Kaoru, reluctant to leave the First Princess's beauty, notices a lower servant woman turning back and hides himself.

scene.content: 薫、昨日垣間見た女一の宮と同じ紅の羅の単衣を縫わせ、几帳に掛け置いたのを手ずから女二の宮に着せようとする。
scene.contenten: Kaoru has a crimson silk robe like the one of the First Princess he glimpsed yesterday sewn and hung on a screen, and tries to dress the Second Princess in it himself.

scene.content: 薫、夕暮れに飛び交う蜻蛉を見て、大君や浮舟とのはかない縁を思う。
scene.contenten: Kaoru watches dragonflies flitting at dusk and thinks of his fleeting ties with the eldest sister and Ukifune.

summaryen: Ukifune disappears, and the ladies left behind, realizing she has attempted suicide by drowning, lament, yet hastily hold a funeral to conceal the truth. Kaoru too learns of it and is plunged in grief. In summer, Kaoru feels himself drawn to his wife's elder sister, Onna Ichi no Miya.

title: 手習
summary: 実は浮舟は、横川の僧都によって入水自殺後に助けられていた。やがて健康が回復した彼女はみずからの名を明かさないまま、入道の志を僧都に告げて髪を下ろす。やがて、明石中宮の加持僧である僧都が浮舟のことを彼女に語ったため、このことが薫の知るところとなる。
gendaibun: 実は浮舟は、横川の僧都によって入水自殺後に助けられていた。やがて健康が回復した彼女はみずからの名を明かさないまま、入道の志を僧都に告げて髪を下ろす。やがて、明石中宮の加持僧である僧都が浮舟のことを彼女に語ったため、このことが薫の知るところとなる。
gendaibunen: Ukifune was saved after her suicide attempt by the Bishop of Yokawa. Recovered, she keeps her name secret, declares her wish for the religious life, and has her hair cut. Later the bishop, serving the Akashi Empress, speaks of her—and Kaoru begins to suspect she lives. …
kobun: 浮舟は横川の僧都に助けられけり。健康回復の後、名を明かさず出家の志を告げて髪下ろす。僧都の話より、薫、生存を疑ひはじむ。……
kobunen: In fact Ukifune had been saved after her attempt to drown by the Bishop of Yokawa; when her strength returned, without giving her name, she told him of her wish to leave the world and had her hair cut. …

scene.content: 宇治院の木の下に倒れ伏す浮舟を僧たち発見。
scene.contenten: Monks discover Ukifune lying collapsed beneath a tree at the Uji monastery.

scene.content: 僧都ら、妹尼の頼みで山を下り、一夜浮舟を加持する。
scene.contenten: The bishop and others, at the younger nun's request, come down the mountain and perform incantations over Ukifune for a night.

scene.content: 秋、浮舟が身を寄せる小野の君の庵の前で、稲を刈る人々、歌を歌い興じあう。
scene.contenten: In autumn, before the hermitage of Lady Ono where Ukifune stays, people harvesting rice sing songs merrily.

scene.content: 浮舟、少将のに誘われて碁を打つ。
scene.contenten: Ukifune plays go at the Shosho's invitation.

scene.content: 尼君の庵に立ち寄った僧都に、浮舟出家したいと願い、几帳の帷子の綻びより髪を掻き出して切ってもらおうとする。
scene.contenten: To the bishop who stops at the nun's hermitage, Ukifune expresses her wish to take the tonsure and tries to have him cut her hair through a tear in the screen curtain.

scene.content: 髪を下ろした浮舟、一人硯に向かい手習いをする。
scene.contenten: Ukifune, having taken the tonsure, sits alone at the inkstone practicing calligraphy.

summaryen: In truth Ukifune, after attempting to drown herself, was saved by the Bishop of Yokawa. As her health recovers, she does not reveal her name, tells the Bishop of her wish to enter the religious life, and takes the tonsure. In time the Bishop, who is the exorcist for Lady Akashi's daughter, speaks of Ukifune to her, and thus the matter comes to Kaoru's knowledge.

title: 夢浮橋
summary: 薫は横川に赴き、浮舟に対面を求めるが僧都に断られ、浮舟の弟・小君に還俗を求める手紙を託す。しかし浮舟は一切を拒んで仏道に専心することのみを思い、返事すらもない。薫は浮舟に心を残しつつ横川を去る。
gendaibun: 薫は横川に赴き、浮舟に対面を求めるが僧都に断られ、浮舟の弟・小君に還俗を求める手紙を託す。しかし浮舟は一切を拒んで仏道に専心することのみを思い、返事すらもない。薫は浮舟に心を残しつつ横川を去る。
gendaibunen: Kaoru goes to Yokawa and asks to see Ukifune; the bishop refuses. He sends a letter through her brother urging her to return to ordinary life, but Ukifune refuses everything, intent only on Buddhist practice, and gives no reply. Kaoru leaves Yokawa with his heart still bound to her. …
kobun: 薫、横川に赴き浮舟に対面を求むるも僧都に断らる。弟・小君に還俗を勧むる文を託すも、浮舟すべて拒みて返事なし。薫、心を残しつつ横川を去る。……
kobunen: Kaoru went to Yokawa and sought an audience with Ukifune; the bishop refused, and Kaoru entrusted her younger brother with a letter asking her to return to lay life—yet Ukifune rejected all, thinking only of the Buddha's path, and sent no answer. …

scene.content: 薫、横川の僧都を訪ね、浮舟入水後の事情を聞き、浮舟の弟の小君に文を届けさせるようにと頼む。
scene.contenten: Kaoru visits the bishop of Yokawa, hears the circumstances after Ukifune's immersion, and asks him to have Ukifune's younger brother Kogimi deliver a letter.

scene.content: 浮舟のいる小野の里の遥か向こうの谷を、薫の立派な行列が通る。 尼たちそれを眺める。
scene.contenten: Kaoru's fine procession passes the valley far beyond the Ono village where Ukifune lives; the nuns watch it.

scene.content: 小君、薫の文を小野の庵室に届け、尼君開いて浮舟にみせる。
scene.contenten: Kogimi delivers Kaoru's letter to the hermitage at Ono; the nun opens it and shows it to Ukifune.

summaryen: Kaoru goes to Yokawa and asks to meet Ukifune, but the Bishop refuses, and he entrusts a letter urging her to return to the world to her younger brother, Kokimi. But Ukifune refuses everything, thinking only of devoting herself to Buddhism, and does not even reply. Kaoru leaves Yokawa with his heart still dwelling on Ukifune.
